tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i bca' yig ngo mtshar nying khu nyes sel legs spel gyi sman 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dhā bod+dhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ rnam dkar dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas srid zhi'i 'dren mchog rkang gnyis gtso bo rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ngo mtshar phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas thar pa'i lam mchog lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgya chen 'phrin las kun gyi 'byung gnas bsod nams zhing mchog rgyal sras 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ /phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas skyabs gsum ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal gyur cig /gling bzhi'i mun pa nyi zla nyid kyis gsal bar nus kyi rgyu skar gzhan gyis de ltar min/ /khams gsum 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa sa skya pa ste 'dren pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /des na yongs 'dzin 'di 'dra'i bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa grangs med bsod nams mthu las byung / /e ma 'di 'dra'i ngo mtshar tshul la spro ba bskyed la dam chos sgrubs dang thar 'dod rnams/ /thog mar thos pa'i sgro 'dogs mthar phyin chod/ /bar du dam pa'i gdams ngag yongs rdzogs nos/ /tha mar don gnyis sgrub la sems khur bskyed/ /rgyun du sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying khongs chongs/ /chos bzhin byed na de las bya rgyu med/ /de las ldog na chos pa min par go /de bzhin thugs la zhog mdzod dge 'dun rnams/ /phyag du bzhes shing thub bstan lha khang pa/ /spyir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las/ dge 'dun gyi sde bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sbyin bdag chos rgyal la rag las par gda' ste/ deng sang gi dus 'di na de rnams mar ngo'i zla ba ltar gyur cing /

de las ldog pa rnams rgyas pa 'di yid skyo ba'i gnas su mchis/ sngon byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gi gsan yig dang / chos 'chad lugs sogs bstan pa spel tshul rnams bsams nas/ deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba dag la bltas tsa na mtshan rtags tsam du gda' ste/ sngon byon pa'i gong ma de dag gis ni bstan 'gro'i phyir sku srog kyang gtong ba la thugs thag bcad nas/ mdzad rgyu bstan pa'i bya ba las med pa zhig mdzad 'dug pa la brten/ zab yangs bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun bzang chad la thug pa rnams rang rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis lugs srol so so dag skyes bu dam pa re res ches cher rgyas par mdzad pas deng sang gi bar du'ang bstan pa'i rgyun cung zad tsam las pa 'dir gda'/ tshul 'di bsam pa'i tshe kho bo dad pa dang spro ba dang skyo ba gsum 'dres ma'i ngang nas mig nas mchi ma du ma dbang med du 'chor gyin 'dug khyed blo ldan rnams kyang tshul 'di soms dang / rje gong ma rnams la dad pa chen po dbang med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kye ma deng sang gi bstan 'dzin du zhal gyis bzhes pa phal cher zang zing gi don du gnyer ba kho na las/ chos 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa'i bya bar 'gyur nges pa rnams lag tu longs yang mi len zhing / len lo rnams kyang chos 'chad pa sogs la long byung ma song zhes 'jig rten gyi bya ba la rkang btsugs dang / chos zhar las byed pa zhig gda' ba/ 'di 'dra rang gi 'khrul tshab la gzigs dang / skyes bu rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba dag bstan pa'i bya ba 'ba' zhig bgyid par 'dod pa la/ deng sang gi mi drag zhan kun de'i mthun rkyen mi sgrub pa'i khar gnod pa ci 'khyol byed pa 'di ni/ spre'u dag gis mi rnams la mjug ma med pa 'di 'dra zhes khrel ba dang mtshungs par mi gda' 'am/ de bzhin du sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis rgyud phyug pa'i bstan pa gsal nus nges pa'i bshes gnyen rnams las blun po sgo phugs kyi 'phrin tsam yang mi 'khyol ba dag gces par 'dzin pa 'di 'dra skyo ba la ang /

bstan pa la 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i rgyu gda' 'am/ khyed blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod par zhu/ deng sang dge 'dun gyi sder gnas pa'i gang zag phal cher yang / gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod lta zhog chos mthun tsam yang bgyid 'dod med pa/ 'di las kha drag pa zhig dang / nor phyug pa zhig thabs ji ltar byas na 'ong ngam snyam pa kho na sems shing / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su bstan pa bshig pa dang / 'dzin pa'i gang zag so sor 'byed pa'i dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams la phal cher mi dga' zhing / de dag khyad med du 'jog pa'i yul de la byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes dad pa ltar byed pa 'di ni ma dag pa'i dad par 'gyur ram snyam mo/ /'di yang blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod par zhu/ mdor na sngon byon gong ma rnams kyis bstan pa spel lugs dang / slob ma rnams kyis don gnyer byed lugs dang / de dag gi skabs rnams su mthun rkyen 'grig lugs sogs/ bstan pa rin po che'i me ro gso lugs rnams mthong ba'i tshe 'di 'dra rang gi ngo mtshar ba snyam pa kho nar 'dug cing / deng sang bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa la mi bsam lugs dang / slob ma rnams kyis don gnyer med lugs dang / gal te bla mas bstan pa bsam/ slob mas don gnyer byas kyang mthun rkyen mi 'grig pa sogs gang nas bsams kyang bstan pa rin po che 'di rgyas pa dka' ba 'dug snyam skyo shas drag po bza' btung mi dran pa lta bu kho bo la yong gin 'dug pa/ khyed blo ldan rnams kyang legs par brtags na de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mi gda' bas legs par brtags par zhu/ legs par brtags nas bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rtse gcig tu bgyis nas spyi sgos kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun bzang po phal cher chad la thug pa 'di rnams thog mar yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas pa zhig ci la thug kyang bya/

de ltar du 'gyur ba bla ma mkhyen snyam du bsams la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / gang snang bden med du shes pa gal che bas de ltar thugs la bzhugs pa zhu/ zhes sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bka'i zegs ma cung zad mchod brjod dang gdams ngag gi tshul du smros nas/ 'dir don gyi snying po bstan 'gro'i bde skyid la gcig tu dgongs nas rang re'i rje btsun gong ma spyi dang / bye brag sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos gdul bya'i snang ngor sku gsung thugs la ngal ba du ma dang bzhes su mdzad de/ yid srubs rnams kyi ngan spyod la tshar gcod rjes bzung bka' drin du bstsal ba'i rnam dkar gyi 'bras bu 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po nas bzung sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyi bar du byon pa'i dpal sa skya'i dgon gnas rje btsun gong ma'i mdo sngags kyi bzhed gzhung / de 'dzin rigs kyi bu slob zhabs 'degs mnga' 'bangs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bcas yongs su rdzogs par nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bur bstsal ba'i nang tshan/ mchog du gyur pa sde snod bstan pa'i gzhi chen po chos grwa lho 'di nyid la sngags 'chang nyid nas bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs rab tu rgyas shing yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ bca' yig chen mo kha skong le tshan dang bcas pa ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs shing / de skabs sngags 'chang nyid kyis dge 'dun rnams la bshad sgrub kyis mtshon bstan pa'i rnam gzhag phra mo tshun chad la'ang 'gal spong 'phrod bsten dgos tshul gyi bka' lan cig min par yang yang bstsal kyang / bstan nyi byams bzang pa sogs lta ba ngan pa'i gdon gyis bslad pa'i ban gzugs 'ga' re nas grub mtha'i phyogs zhen bstan bshig sna tshogs byas par/ sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyis tshogs su bka' bkyon dos drag dang / dge 'dun byin nas mdo sgrub gnad rdung bcas gdug can rnams tshar gcod bka' drin bskyangs pas bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan zhing /

dge 'dun byings la sgrig lam kun spyod mtha' dag bogs 'don lta bur gyur pa dang / rjes su'ang 'jam dbyangs sku mched nas bzung bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid kyi bar du byon pa'i bla ma gong ma rim can nas chos khrims la spyan 'bras ltar gces spras su mdzad pa'i bka' drin gyis deng sang gi bar du'ang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po sogs bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang phal cher mthun yang / spyir rtsod dus pha la phar mi 'dzin/ ma la mar mi 'dzin/ dge sbyong la dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa sogs ngan spyod sna tshogs byas pa'i rgyu las/ 'bras bu snyigs ma lnga ldan 'byung bar gsungs pa dang / khyad par deng sang gi dus 'o skol so skye rnams rmu rgod kha rgyal/ rgyal ba bye bas kyang gdul dka'i rang bzhin las/ sngon gyi bla ma gong mas bcad khrims sogs rang gzhan la phan bde 'byung ba rnams gal chung du bzhag ston pa ngan pa'i sgros dang log spyod la rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin dwang len byas pas yang dag pa'i ring lugs rnams sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar sil bur 'thor nas lo re bzhin sde snod kyi bshar sbyang sogs sgrig lam kun spyod tshang ma rim gyis je zhan 'gro ba'i sgo dod 'dra mo shar ba blos ma bzod par/ da lam chos grwa lho byang gi mkhan rin po che gsar bkod thog sgrig lam kun spyod la phan pa'i bca' yig rgyab bsnon dgos tshul gsungs par ma zad/ nged rang gi bsam par yang snga mo nas gang ci'i rgyu mtshan zhib cha 'khod pa'i bca' tsho zhib rtsom 'dun che yang / nged rang le lo'i 'dam rdzab tu chud cing dus gnas dang bstun pa'i lha bu'i bdud kyi rnam 'phrul du ma la g.yeng bas don chen gal chung du lus pas da bar 'gyangs song yang / da lam skabs don gyi snying po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bca' yig gi snying khu zhar byung yan lag dang bcas ma tshang ba med pa'i tshul du zhu na bca' yig chen mo las/

bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya 'di nyid du mkhas grub ji snyed cig byon nas bshad sgrub mdzad tshul spyi dang / khyad par chos rje khu dbon gyis bshad grwa ngo mtshar can 'dzugs par mdzad tshul rnams gsungs pa'i mthar/ phyis 'byung dus kyi shugs dang yid srubs kyi byed pa la brten sde snod phyogs kyi bshad grwa ming gi lhag ma tsam gyi re ba las kyang dman par song 'dug pa la brten/ bdag gis lhag pa'i bsam pa rma med pas lus dang srog la yang bdag gir bgyi ba lhod par bgyis te/ dus ring mo zhig nas drag la rgyun mi chad pa'i gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi 'bad pa lhur bgyid pa'i don du brnag par bya ba'i 'bras bu slar yang sde snod kyi bshad grwa gsar du btsugs pa 'dir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis kun spyod mdzad dgos la zhes gsungs nas/ de'i rjes su zhib cing phra bar ljags bkod gnang 'dug kyang / 'dir kun gyis thugs la nges pa'i phyir brjed tho snying po lta bur brjod na/ nges 'byung dang byang sems kyi sgo nas gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dgos par so so'i cho ga'i sgo nas dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa blangs te/ bslab bya mtha' dag mkhan slob kyis ji ltar bstan pa bzhin sems la dran 'dzin drag po btang ste bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa dang / bslab pa bgres pa rnams kyis bslab bya dran bskul yang yang mdzad cing / de la gzhon pa rnams kyis gus pas nyan pa ni shin tu gal che zhing / gal te sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis rtsa bzhi gang rung la skyon byung nas dge 'dun dang lhan cig gnas na rang nyid tho lum me 'bar za ba'i dmyal bar skye zhing dge 'dun byings la nyams grib phog nas thos bsam sgom gsum la 'gal rkyen byed pas drag zhan su yin kyang gan brdung gnas dbyung gis mtshams gcod byed/ mi tshangs spyod kyi cha 'khrig tshig tsam yang mi brjod/

ma byin len gyi cha nas phul gang tsam yang mi rku/ srog gcod kyi cha grog sbur tsam yang mi gsod/ brdzun gyi cha ku re'i phyir yang mi smra/ phra ma'i cha tshig gcig kyang mi 'jug gzhan phan gyi phyir ma gtogs tshig ngan gyi cha phran bu yang mi 'don/ bstan bcos ngan pa 'don pa'i ngag dang glu dang kha gsag dmag dang smad 'tshong ma'i gtam bya ba sogs mdor na phal pa'i kha 'chal 'brel med rnams yin par gsungs/ ngag 'khyal la'ang ci nus su bsrung sdom byed/ rdzas yo byad gang la'ang brnab sems mi bya/ gnod len gnod 'jal gyi bsam pa mi skye/ yul mchog dman gang la'ang dgos med kyi log lta mi bya/ nyes pa 'di dag byas pa ngos zin na mkhan rin po che dang chos khrims pas rgan gzhon/ kha drag zhan/ yul gnyen mi gnyen su yin kyang rung rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir nye ring ngo dga' 'jig rten ngo 'dzin sogs chos dang mi mthun pa'i skyabs kha spangs te 'phral brgya phyag 'gel/ phyag 'tshal mkhan gyis kyang 'gyod tshangs shes pa'i sgo nas rang dang ma gyur sems can thams cad lus zhing rdul mnyam par sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing / ngag nas sdig bshags brjod pa/ yid kyis phyin chad srog la babs kyang sgrig 'gal mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems dang bcas chos khrims pas tshod ma bzung bar la mthil lnga sa la bab pa'i phyag 'tshal/ gal te blos ma longs kyi rnam 'gyur byas pa byung na brgya phyag gsum bldab dang / tshogs khang du mchod me mar nyag lnga 'gel/ grwa tshang dkrugs shing byas pa sogs byung na de la spyi chos khrims pas len thongs par gyis/ hor khrims kyi rtsa ra byas pa rang phan pa yin/ bud med 'grim pa byung na mar zho do'i chad pa dge 'dun gyi 'jam rdor la 'bul/ chang bag med du 'grim pa byung na tshod re la mar khal re sogs mang nyung la dpag pa'i chad pa gong bzhin 'bul/ chang snod rdeb pa dang chag dum 'du khang gi sgor thog

lo ra lo thog 'joms pa/ sho mig mang rdo skor/ mda' rtsed/ 'phyongs sogs byas pa byung na brgya phyag 'gel/ nad la phan phyir 'du dgos byung na ma gtogs don med la tshogs nas smra ba mang na nyon mongs g.yo zhing phan tshun rtsem zol du 'gro ba dang / chos 'chad nyan slob gnyer rim gro sgrig sogs la 'gal ba'i 'thab rtsod bsnyung gzhi sogs mi dge ba 'byung nges yin pas rang rang gi gnas su sems rnal du pheb/ blo bla ma dkon mchog la gtod pa gal che/ tshogs su long gtam smra ba/ du ba gtong ba sogs byung na ngo bsrung med pa'i brgya phyag 'gel/ kha 'thab lag 'thab rma khrag 'pho ba sogs byung na/ 'di khar bla ma spyi chos kyis 'phral du gtugs ngos chad pa dran 'dzin babs thob re nged rang gi kha ltas khyab par byed/ tshogs nam 'tshog dus dung sogs brda byung 'phral brtson 'grus bskyed de phyi shol med par cig char 'dus ngos/ gding ba zhwa ser mthang sham sogs rab byung gi chas ma gtogs skya bo'i chas sogs ya ma zung rnams tshogs la mi gtong / gdan non byung tshe lhung bzed ma gtogs thang rkyal mi 'khyer/ dril thogs cho gar khro bo spyan 'dren ma zin na mar rkyal spyi chos kyis bsdus nas dkar mer 'bul/ zhes gsungs dang / gong gi chas gtsang ma yod na ma gtogs mi gtong gsungs pa'i rjes su/ bde chen gling pa rnams te rang gi bca' yig bzhin dgos tshul dang / 'dir phyogs nas byon pa rnams dang sngags bon btsun ma drug mthil rnams kyang cha lugs lugs mthun yod na ma gtogs mi gtong tshul gsungs 'dug kyang / de dag so so la bca' yig zur gsal re rtsom 'dun yod pas 'dir ma bris/ de'i rjes su mang ja gung tshigs dgong thun gyi chos spyod rnams gsungs 'dug kyang dbu byed la tho zur gsal zhig bkod yod pas 'dir ma bris/ de 'phros tshogs gyes 'tshog gi dus pi shā tsi 'ur 'don dang /

dbu byed nas kyang chos spyod phyag deb bzhin ma gtogs blo bzos snon 'phri mi byed/ chos spyod tshang ma dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs la yod nges dgos rgyu la/ btsun gsar rnams grwa tshang du slebs nas zla ba bdun gyi khongs su chos spyod tshang ma 'dzin thub pa byas/ mkhan sku dngos sam tshab drung chen/ dbu chos las thog pas bshar gnon byed/ ma bzung ba byung na gnad che chung la dpag pa'i mar chad dge 'dun gyi 'jam rdor la 'bul/ chos tshugs phyin dmigs bsal ma gtogs rgyal sgo brgal nas phyin pa byung na nyin re la mar nyag do re'i chad pa spyi chos kyis bsdus nas gong bzhin byed/ grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi chos khrims chos 'chad chos mtshams phyag bzhes mdzad rgyu tshang ma rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi gsung rab dang mthun pa mkhas dbang g.yag rong gnyis kyi bzhed gzhung mdzad dgos gsungs pa'i rjes su chos kyi sku rim mdzad rgyu zhig 'dug kyang / deng sang ni dmigs khungs zhig ma byung / de'i rjes su chos dang chos mtshams kyi rnam gzhag gsungs pa rnams bca' yig chen mo bzhin bya/ de 'phros rig lung la tshang ma 'byon dgos sgrig zhugs rnams kyis so so'i gzhung chos tshang ma nyan pa dang / de las 'gal na mkhan spyi chos gros mthun gyi chad pa 'os rigs 'gel/ rig lung dang snga dgong gi skyong ran la chos khrims pas bskor g.yengs mkhan po'i bka' dang bstun nus pas byas rting ngan khreb kyis ma byas pa byung na gong bzhin gros mthun gyi chad pa 'gel/ mkhan spyi chos sogs las tshan tshang mas phyogs cha nye ring kun slong le lo rang 'dod spang / ngo dga' las sla 'khur med ma yin pa'i grwa tshang gi spyi byus kho na la bsam/ dkon mchog dpang du btsugs/ bca' yig la cha bzhag pa'i sems khur 'chugs med sra thang byed dgos/ yang las tshan rnams kyis tshul bzhin ma byas pa byung na dge 'dun byings nas nged rang la lan gsal slebs par gyis/

bden rdzun brtags pas kha ta sogs dran 'dzin gang yong gtong ba yin/ yang las tshan rnams kyis 'thad bzhin byas kyang ngan mnan gtad zas min mi chen bsgul ba sogs yin par sems khog bcangs dgos med kyi brnyad brko zhe mi nyan byas pa byung na 'di nas hor khrims sogs gang 'tshams kyis do dam byed pa yin zhing / snyigs dus 'dir 'chad nyan grwa tshang gi sgrig lugs mthun 'di gzhan las phan yon che zhing / gcur dag sgrig khyon yang shin tu dka' ba zhig yong 'dug pas/ chos khrims kho nas ma non na gdug rtsub can la rgyal khrims kyis kyang gcur dgos bcas/ dge 'dun gyi dpang por las tshan rnams/ de'i dpang por nged rang / de'i dpang po bla ma dkon mchog bzhugs pa yin pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde la bsams pa'i sgrig lugs mthun sngags 'chang nyid kyi bca' yig 'di bzhin cis kyang mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gdan sa chen po 'di'i nyams gso spyi dang / bye brag chos grwa 'di nyid kyi ched du sngags 'chang nyid kyis 'o brgyal ji ltar bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ de skabs su bdud kyi gnas mal snying la bcas pa'i sde dpon 'ga' re'i byed ngan la brten gdan sa 'di 'phel rgyas lta zhog 'jig nyer thug skabs/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku lus sku srog ltos med du btang / theg chen byang sems kyi go cha bzang po bzhes te sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du ya 'ud kyi thugs smon gnang / rgyal khams kun la dal med du phebs bzhugs sogs tshang ma shin tu dka' spyad mdzad skabs la lar gshegs song dgongs pa dang / la lar bkrongs song dgongs pa dang / la lar thugs dran med du 'gro ba sogs ci byung yang thugs sun thugs 'gyod kyi rnam pa gtan ma mdzad par/ dgongs bzhed kyi gtso bo sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde dang bcas pa la phan pa zhig byung na ci byas kyi bde/ de mi yong na rang rkyang pa sku tshe thung yang bzod dgongs pa'i thugs dam drag po bcas nas dkon mchog gsum 'dus kyi ngo bo sa lo chen por rtse gcig gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i byin rlabs dang sngags 'chang nyid kyi thugs rjes/

byang rgyal sogs chos rgyal stobs chen rnams kyis log sgrub chom 'bebs kyi las mdzad de/ gdan sa chen por chos gzhis sogs 'bul sbyor rgya cher mdzad pa rnams kyang sku rkyang gi bdag gir ma mdzad par/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi 'dzin skyong spel gsum spyi dang / khyad par chos sde'i gzhi rten du sa yul dngos gtsang pa nas son 'gro lag thog yod nges pa bre'i khal sum brgya 'byed 'grol mdzad pa sogs zhib cha'i rnam dbye spyi debs su gsal ba ltar las tshan dge 'dun bcas kyi thugs la bzhag gzhig pa bcug 'phral phugs su bsam mno btang ba'i spang blang gnang dgos gsungs pa'i rjes su thugs smon tshig lhug dang tshigs bcad bcas byin rlabs can bka' drin bskyangs 'dug cing / de rjes 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad do zer ba'i bca' yig zhabs 'degs nyung ngu zhig 'dug pa las/ 'dir snying po bkod na/ gling so sor gling dpon bsko bzhag mdzad tshul gyi mthar/ de dag na bzhugs pa'i gling dpon so sos rang rang gi dge gzhon la bslab bya byed tshul ni/ de yang 'phral gyi spyod lam/ za lugs/ 'gro lugs/ sdod lugs/ gos gyon lugs sogs spyod lam thams cad kyang 'dul ba'i gzhung nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems zhi zhing dul ba byed dgos tshul dang / tshogs 'du 'tshog chos grwa rig lung sogs la gan+dhe sogs brda nam byung la rtsol ba bskyed de 'gro ba'i rting skul byed pa dang / rang nyid kyang rtsol ba bskyed nas 'gro dgos/ tshogs su slebs nas kyang rang la ltos pa'i slob ma de ngan spyod byed mi byed sogs brtags la/ gal srid byed kyin 'dug na dran 'dzin cung zad dang bcas kha ta bslab bya tshul bzhin du byed dgos/ de ltar slob dpon so sos byas na tshogs 'du 'tshogs sogs la las tshan gyis gcur dag la ma ltos par rang khrims su rang shugs kyis 'gro bas so so nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa shin tu gal che/

gal srid rang nyid tshogs la med pa'am yod kyang rang gi slob ma de spyod ngan byed pa ma rig par chos khrims pa dang dbu byed dang las tshan so sos spyod ngan byed pa de la dran 'dzin btang ba byung na yang de'i ngan rgyab mi byed par slar yang rang gi slob ma ngan spyod byed pa de la dran 'dzin cung zad dang bcas bslab bya tshul bzhin byed pa gal che/ grwa khang so so na gnas pa'i tshe snyoms las su ma song bar bshad nyan la 'bad dgos/ de yang gsar bu rnams la chos spyod klog la sogs pa rtsol ba bskyed de slob dgos/ chos spyod klog la sogs pa 'byongs pa dang / bsdus ra slob pa shin tu gal che/ bsdus ra chag pa rnams la rtsa pod gnyis la thog mar rtsal tu thon pa gal che/ de nas po ti phyi ma la rim gyis 'jug pa gal che/ de yang slob dpon so so blo gsal mi gsal dang / slob ma yang sngar slob dpon gzhan las slob bzhin pa'i ngag khyun 'dris pa yod cing / de la bslabs pas blo bskyed che ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can yod na gling dpon du bkod pa'i slob dpon de la ltos med du ma song bar lugs mthun gyi grol cha zhu dgos/ gnas kyi slob dpon des kyang khyi bong ro bsrung du ma song bar lhag bsam rnam par dag pas grol cha btang ste kho'i slob gnyer gyi gegs su mi 'gro bar byed pa gal che/ de ltar slob gnyer gyi rting skul yin pas slob pa blo bskyed gang che sar slob pa las 'os med kyang / rang gi gnas kyi slob dpon de la dbang che she mong gi ltag gyer mi byed par gong du 'khur te gling der bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i zhig gso kha gso byed pa/ sa rtsi gling 'debs pa sogs slob dpon des ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dang len byas te skyid sdug stabs gcig tu byed pa dang / gal srid gling tshang der slob dpon la sogs pa brel ring gi stabs byung na yang /

der gnas rnams kyis gling la sa rtsi gtong ba sogs tshul bzhin du byed dgos/ mdor na gnas pa slob dpon rnams kyis kyang lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas 'phral gyi spyod lam phugs kyi slob gnyer rting bskul bslab bya tshul bzhin byed dgos/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang gling dpon du bkod pa de gong du khur te chos mthun gyi bya ba byed dgos tshul bslab bya byas pa thams cad dwang len bya dgos/ mdor na slob dpon so sos lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bslab bya ma byas pa la brten nas slob ma sus nyes pa byung na'ang nged rang gis brtag dpyad byas ngos slob dpon rang la dran 'dzin gtong zhing / slob dpon gyis bslab kyang slob mas ma nyan pa'i nyes pa byung na slob ma rang la dran 'dzin gtong nges pas so so nas dran shes brtan pos spang blang 'dzol med gal che/ 'di dag gi do dam par gtso bor mkhan chen/ spyi chos khrims/ dbu byed bcas kyis byas pa'i phyogs cha nye ring le lo'i dbang du ma song ba'i rus thon dgos rgyu dang / gal te las tshan gyis ma 'thus pa byung tshe nged rang la gsal slebs par gyis zhes zer ba 'dug pas 'di ni 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsung ma 'dra na'ang / drang gtam go sla zhig 'dug par 'dir bris shing / de rjes sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can gyi bka' shog cig 'dug kyang chang gi do dam kho na las gzhan ci yang ma gsungs pas 'dir ma bkod/ phyis su bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid kyis chos grwa lho byang gnyis su bka' shog cig gnang 'dug pa las/ lhor gnang ba'i bka' shog gi snying po/ deng sang gi skabs su des rkyang pa dang btsun chung sogs slob gnyer skor la rig grwa lung grwa/ bsdus ra ba sogs dar rgyas ci che dgos pa mang ja'i gung gseng sogs la chos khrims pas 'gyangs gzhir ma song ba bgro gleng la zhabs bskul zhu ba dang / chos thog le tshan rnams la rgyugs 'bul ba shin tu nyung ba ni/

btsun chung rnams dpe cha tshugs pa 'phyi ba dang / ma tshugs pa dge rgan bzhugs min la gseng shor mang ba bcas yong 'dug pa/ btsun chung rnams 'dod pa ma rnyed pas de la dga' ba gzhir bcas kyang / gling so so'i dge rgan dang / gling tshang rang rang gi thab tshang rgan pa rnams nas mgo 'og lus 'chur gyi phugs rigs dge gzhon la drin chung du ma song ba'i sha tsha'i sgo nas drin chen yong ba'i bskul brda dang / bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs 'degs thugs la bcangs pa'i mdzad sgo khyab che ngos/ de yang snga sor gyi dpe cha ran tshod las snga ba/ snga dpe yang tshugs snga ba/ dus rtag pa/ skyong ran yang rgyun ring mtha' 'khyol bar mdzad pas dbyar chos dgun chos rnams la gling re nas rgyugs 'bul ba gnyis gsum re thon pa nges par dgos rgyu dang / mdza' tshogs kyi bza' btung la 'du tshogs 'di slob gnyer gyi pad kho nar 'dug pas so so'i thugs kyis dpyad pa'i g.yeng ba gang chung la dge rgan so so nas 'jur dam gang drag mdzad na bstan pa dang rang gzhan thams cad la phan slebs che ba yong 'dug mang ja sogs tshogs 'du'i rigs la rang re yon mchod gnyis char tshogs rdzogs phyir yin pas/ zhal 'don rnams dal bus btang zhing gzhan gyi yang thugs ngal ring bar mdzad na/ mchod gnas rang gi gsol ba'i yon sbyong ba dang / yon bdag gi 'di phyi'i don 'grub pa sogs rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las 'bras bu 'phral yun gyi phan bde thob pa/ dgongs chod ltar dang / zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su ban gtsang pa'i skor phran bu gsungs 'dug kyang zur gsal yod pas 'dir ma bris/ de 'phros gong ltar tshogs pa rnams kyi thugs la bzhugs rgyu'i bslab sbyangs zhib tu bkrol ba 'di rnams mkhan rin po che nas bzung las tshan rim can/ gling so so'i dge rgan rnams nas btsun gsar yan thams cad la bya spu gnon gyi tshul du spangs blangs go 'dzol med par bskul gnon gal che/

gal te re gnyis nas don ma go ba'i tshig don la mi gnas pa 'dra byung srid na las tshan rnams nas skungs bsubs med pa'i 'di gar gsal skyel ba las 'os ma 'das/ zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su/ dal 'byor gyi lus thob nas rang gzhan la phan bde spel ba'i bya ba byed dgos tshul zur tsam gsungs pa sogs mdor na bla ma gong ma mtha' dag nas sde snod kyi bshad grwa khyad par can 'di'i sgrig lam kun spyod la gzhan las do dam che bar mdzad 'dug kyang bca' yig sgrog ma brtags shing / las tshan rnams thugs sbugs che ba dang / grwa bgres rnams rang rang gi gdong gang la gzigs shing bstan don la rgya g.yengs med du skyur ba dang / nged rang dang lo mtshungs lta bu'i gzhon grwa rnams gshed khyer zong khur gyis bsdo thub na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang rgol ba'i blo stobs can mang ba bcas rgyu mtshan du mas sgrig la lhad zhugs tshul zur tsam bkod na/ thog mar btsun chung gi dus byis pa mon ma shes pa lta bus ngan spyod cung zad 'byung ba bden yang rgan pa rnams khog bcug gi bya ba bzang ngan sna tshogs dang / tho co ya med byed 'dug pas/ 'di dag la'ang chung ngu nas skyon ma thon na phugs ngan longs tshabs chen du 'gro bas 'phral gyi kun spyod rnams la dge rgan so so nas gnas skabs kun tu zhib 'jug byas pa'i kha ta sogs 'jur dag zhi drag gang rung 'thus ma shor ba byed cing / thog mar ka kha nas bzung chos spyod nas 'dzin dgos kyang / gling dpon dge rgan rnams nas bslab bya'i rtsa ba ma bzung bar brten/ chos spyod ma song bar bka' bzhin sogs 'dzin pa dang / de dag kyang rgyugs 'bul skabs tshul ldan mi yong tshul thos pas da cha 'dzin chos bslab bya so so'ang gling rnams kyi dge rgan gtso bo de nas rtsa ba rkang blang gi grogs dan/ thab tshang rgan pa dang gling pa sogs so so nas dge rgan gyi rjes su zhugs pa'i bya spu gnon bstar chags dang /

snga sor sgrig la khyon nas kyang dpe cha 'dzin skyor tshang ma btsun chung dang stabs gcig byed cing rang gzhung mang du skyor tshe sku rim sgrig 'don la mi 'gro na'ang / nyung ngu las med tshe sgrig 'don kyang btsun chung bzhin byed tshul dge rgan nas do dam byed/ lhag par lho sgo'i rigs grwa tal yug ma 'di la bsdus ra dang phar tshad gnyis nas bzung dbu sdom gyi bar rim can yang dag ci dgos bstan pa'i rnam gzhag sgrig lam gyi gtso bo yin kyang / deng sang bsdus ra dang dbu sdom gnyis kyi rig grwa chag skad thos pas btsun chung rnams kyis da nas bzung sngar rgyun bzhin rig lung gi lde mig bsdus ra chad med rtsi dgos rgyur/ snga sor phywa pa chos seng nas bzung bsdus ra 'di dbus phyogs su dar zhing / gtsang phyogs su cung zad zhan par brten/ chos grwa chen po 'dir yang snga thog nas bsdus ra byang chub pa'i rtags gsal ha cang bde ba zhig ma byung kyang / dus phyis mkhan rin po che kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal bzang gnyis bsdus rar cung byang chub pa'i slob grwa nas mkhas pa 'dra deng sang yang grwa bgres kyi gras su yod skad dang / lhag par mkhan rin po che khri thog pa 'di mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' zla 'od nas bsdus ra mkhas gras su gzigs pa'i sgrig la'ang dgos dpyad kyis phebs chog byung 'dug pa bcas gtso cher mkhan rin po che nas khas blangs sogs bka' khyab gnang dgos tshul nged rang gis zhus don bzhin gnang yong 'gro zhing / de bas kyang rtag pa ni rang rang gi dge rgan las rag las pas dge rgan tshang ma nas bsdus dpe 'dzin chos su sprad nas de'i go don btsun chung so so'i blo gros dang bstun pa'i zhib gsed yang yang mdzad pa dang / gal te dge rgan rang nas bsdus ra la de tsam gyi byang chub med na bsdus ra mkhas pa dag gi drung bshar sbyangs la 'gro dgos kyi khyab 'doms che bar mdzad ngos song lo gnang lo tsam la bsdus ra ba 'gran med zhe gcig yong ba'i do dam gang che dang de rjes phar tshad 'dul mngon rtsi gzhag mdzad mi rnams la deng sang gi 'di bas lhag pa zhu ma dgos kyang /

da dung 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang kun mkhyen chen po'i yig cha dang / de'i rjes 'brang gi gtso bo ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang chos grags dang / mkhan dbang chos rnam rgyal gyi yig cha sogs rang rang blo gros che chung gis gzigs rtog mdzad ngos/ de dag gi bgro gleng zhib cha rang re'i rje btsun gong ma rnams dgos shing phyogs kyi mkhas grub yi rang ba dang / rgol ngan gyi spobs pa 'phrog pa sogs mdor na chos rje khu dbon g.yag rong go shāka rnams zhing 'dir slar yang 'byon pa lta bu'i mkhas pa'i snyan grags sa steng thams cad la khyab pa zhig so so'i dgongs 'jags dang / dbu sdom gnyis la'ang sngar rgyun bzhin rab 'byams pa bgres pa'i yang rtse rnams sgyid lug snyoms las btang snyoms su mi bzhugs par rtsi bzhag yang dag mdzad pa'i zab mo lta ba'i yang rtse dbu ma'i gzhung lugs nyi 'od ltar gsal ngos/ lta ba ngan pa'i mun pa ming yang mi grags pa zhig dgos rgyu dang / rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po sdom gsum rab dbye la'ang thugs rab kyi 'jug pa rgya cher bskyed ngos so thar byang sems sngags sdom gyi dka' gnas mtha' dag bkrol nas rang gzhan la phan bde'i dga' ston rgya cher spel ba dang / 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sun dbyung sa lam gyi rnam gzhag sogs zhib cha tshang ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid mngon sum byon nas slar yang bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu 'di la 'bru snon zhib gsed bka' drin bskyangs pa lta bu zhig dgos rgyu yin pas/ khyed grwa bgres rnams kyang rgan po ya med kyi gras su mi bzhugs par bstan don 'di la theg pa khur blang gi gtso bor brtson 'grus kyis 'byon pa dang / de bzhin tu sgrig kyi gtso bo chos thog so so'i chos grwa 'di yin cing / de'i thog mar chos gtor la bca' yig gi shugs bstan thams cad 'byon dgos kyang /

da lta skyor 'go ba sogs kha shas las mi 'byon cing / mkhan por dgongs pa zhu ba yang med skad 'dug pas/ slan chad chos gtor la tshang ma byon nas zhal 'don dag gsal bton pas sku rim gtor ma 'gyur che smin grub sngon 'gro'i dgun chos dang gnyis/ dpyid chos dang gnyis/ dbyar chos dang gnyis rnams la mkhan rin po che nas phar phyin par 'dzin chos la phar phyin dka' 'grel nas gnang / gsung slob la yum don rab gsal nas gnang / rnam 'grel bar rgyugs la ṭīka chen kun bzang dang / slob mtshams la sde bdun rab gsal nas/ bka' rams par blo chen shes bya ma nas slebs mtshams bka' rams pa rnam 'grel ba yin na 'dzin chos phar phyin pa'i grwar 'gro/ phar phyin pa yin na rnam 'grel pa'i grwar 'gro/ bsdus ra bar mtshan mtshon rdzas ldog sogs la rtags gsal gsung ngag nas gnang / ston chos la phar phyin par phar phyin gyi ṭīka gzhung nas gnang / rnam 'grel bar rnam 'grel gyi ṭīka gzhung nas/ bka' rams par sdom gsum rab dbye nas/ bsdus ra bar bsdu dpe nas gnang ba ltar so sos nges shing byang chub par bya/ bsdus chung pa la slob mtshams gang bslabs pa de chos khrims pas gral rim mam gling rim lta bus bsdus chung pa rnams gnon/ de skor bgres gzhon tshang mas nyin re'i thos bsam rnams byas grub bstun gyis/ thug tshul la'ang chos gtor ma byung bar la mi 'byon na dgongs pa zhu dgos kyang rang mtshams kyi bzhugs pa thos pas sngar srol bzang po ltar bya dgos shing / dbu zur gyi skabs tshang ma 'dzoms mthar chos khrims pa slebs nas kyang dbu byed ma 'byor bar sgug dgos pa dang / 'byor 'phral skabs 'ga' zhig tu dkar chab kho nas thug tshul chos spyod kyi go chod pas gyes 'gro ba zhig thos pas 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i bca' yig rin po cher gsal ba'i chos spyod rnams rtsa chag tu song bar bkra mi shis shing sgrig la'ang shin tu gnod pa bcas slan chad dbu byed rim can nas do khur chen pos yongs nas chos spyod tshang ma sngags 'chang chen po'i bca' yig gi nang bzhin dang /

de'i rjes dbu byed rnying pa khyad par can rnams kyi ngag rgyun thos brgyud bzang po grwa bgres rnams kyi thugs gsal ltar yin kyang / dbu zur skabs lji yang sna tshogs byung 'dug pa dang / nged rang gi rim gro sogs gzhis kyis mang ja 'phar ma rnams dang / shi gson gyi dge bar dmigs phyi 'dren ji snyed byung ba rnams la'ang dmigs bsal med tshe chos spyod re mos kyis btang srol yod 'dug kyang / dbu zur skabs 'ga' zhig la chos spyod 'bungs che ba dang / 'ga' zhig la ja mchod mdor bsdus zhig btang nas gyes 'gro ba thos par ma zad nged rang gis bltas kyang 'du khang du 'tshogs 'phral lag bde ba rnams ma thon par tshogs pa gyes 'gro ba lta bu zhig lan gcig min par yang yang mthong kyang / le lo'i dbang gis da bar rgyu mtshan zhu ma thub mod/ mdzod pa nas dbu zur la ster byas phran bu dang bcas mang jar lji yang snyoms pa'i chos spyod btang dgos tshul lab skabs/ dbu byed nas khas blangs pos thag byas kyang yang tig zhag kha shas tshul ldan yin rgyu'i khungs la slar rim gyis sngar shul du chud cing / de dag gi sngon du mkhan zur bzhugs pa khri khar phebs 'phral smon lam 'phar ma'i 'don pa shin tu myur bas snga mo nas grol skabs de 'phral dbu byed 'bod mi bka' drin bskyangs bzhed che yang / dbu byed ma bsdad cing / de'i sang sku mdun du bos te bka' bkod gnang skabs rtsi med zhu ba ham chen byas par ma zad/ de nas bzung zhag shas bar la mang ja tshogs yun shin tu ring ba bcas ltar snang la mkhan rin po che'i gsung sor bzhag yin khul dang / don de skabs tsam nas bzung rim gyis bstan bshig sna tshogs dang / khyad par thug tshul nas bzung chos spyod rnams la snon 'phri 'brel med sna tshogs byas 'dug kyang gtso bor las tshan dbu yod rnams nas bzung nye 'khor ba tshang mas ngos la de skor gyi rgyu mtshan sus kyang ma byung ba dang /

dbu byed la zhal ta gtan ma mdzad pa'i nyes pa lta bus da bar sgrig gnod 'byams klas dge 'dun rnams phan tshun khengs pa'i rgyu chen po byung 'dug pa 'di thad la las tshan tshang mar kha ta tsha drag can sogs rjes gnon tsha 'ded dgos nges su 'dug kyang da lam 'then/ dbu byed la 'pho len thog phyis kyi dbu byed rim can nas thug tshul dus ja gung tshigs/ dgong thun/ phyi nang gi mang ja 'phar ma/ dgongs rdzogs ser 'du chen mo/ 'bum ther dus 'phar smon lam rnam gnyis/ hor zla bzhi pa'i dge tsha/ gzhis lan rab 'byams bzhugs gral/ dbyar mthong / rig bya tshogs chen cho ga sogs kun rig gi rigs/ tshe chog rnam rgyal/ bstan pa gso chog sogs mdor na bskul 'os tshang ma bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba'i rgyas bsdus 'tshams shing dkrig char gyi deb zur gsal zhig nged rang nas bcos don bzhin la thag pa khur blangs bgyis ngos/ chos rgyal ma sogs chos spyod dbyangs chen rnams dang / bar gdangs/ gdangs thung / 'dur ma/ bshur ma sogs mdor na sngon gyi gsung rgyun thos brgyud tshang ma slad kyi dbu mdzad rim can nas rang la nges 'grongs yod na de bzhin dang / de min grwa bgres khungs thub rnams la 'bad pa chen pos gtugs ngos rang gi'ang de bzhin du bskul zhing / bskul chung pa sogs gzhan la'ang de bzhin byed dgos pa'i kha ta dang / dge rgan so so la'ang mel ba'i grwa tshang byings nas kyang dbu byed rang gis ji ltar bskul ba bzhin mdzad dgos tshul zhus pa'i gong bkod tshang ma 'phar chag med pa zhig byed pa dang / de snga phan grwa tshang byings nas dbu byed la ma bstun pa dal brel rang rang gis gang dran bab 'chol du skyor ba zhig yod 'dra ba/ 'di ni 'dul ba'i gzhung dang yang 'gal te/ mu stegs kyi char kha bsrung ba'i phyir mgon med zas sbyin gyis nyan thos rnams zhal 'don 'grig po dgos tshul zhus shing / ston pas bram ze rigs byed 'don gdangs gnang bar mdzad pas kyang shes shing /

spyir btang la'ang rang gang dran byas chog na bla ma dkon mchog nas bzung gong bzhugs thams cad mi dgos pa lta bur 'gro ba dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal bo'i bca' yig chen mor/ mkhan spyi dbu byed chos khrims pa sogs las sne tshang mar byings nas bstun dgos tshul lan cig min pa yang yang bka' stsal ba dang yang 'gal bas slan chad dbu byed kyi tshul min ma byas phyin/ 'don cha'i skor tshang ma dbu byed rang sor bzhag las rang rang gi 'dod rgyal mi mdzad pa dang gzhan yang 'dul ba'i rnam gzhag gi gtso bo nang sdom pas rgyud bcings nas/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba zhi dul bag ldan kho na byed dgos par gnas skabs kun tu 'dul ba yul chos dang bstun zhes pa ltar bod kyi rab byung la zhwa dar bas ja 'dren sogs dus kun tu zhwa dang / na bza' bzhes tshul legs shing / mang ja sogs chab len 'os rnams la'ang chab ma rdzogs par gyes 'gro ba zhig yod 'dug pas da nas tshang mar chab rdzogs nas gyes/ bzhud skabs bshar rgyugs mi mdzad par dal bus 'byon/ bzhugs skabs ha cang gi dgyed rgur ya yo 'khyag 'khyog tu ma song bar bzhugs gral gang 'grig dang / bza' btung rnams kyang langs nas byed pa sogs ha cang mi mdzes pa'i longs spyod tshul du ma song bar bag ldan gyis gsol tshul sngar gyi mig ltos bzang po ltar dang / rig lung zhal 'don gsung sgrog sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs rang bzhin gyis ngan sgros la sgra gang chung dang / lhag par mi skya pho mo btsun ma'i rigs yod par ngag bab 'chol du mi gtong zhing / tshogs su 'phros gtam gyi rigs dgos gal shin tu che na ma gtogs gtan nas mi mdzad/ bla ma dge 'dun khyad gsod kyi rnam 'gyur mi 'os pa dang / gnyid kyi dbang du song nas gang yang mi dran pa dang / gsung sgrogs kyi skabs rnams su chos po ti la dngos po phal pa lta bu'i brnyas bcos mi byed pa len bzhugs kyi skabs gus 'dud kyis chud zos med par bya ba dang /

klog 'don gyi skabs 'gom yug zhwa gos kyis gnon pa/ zas snod gsol chas sogs de'i khar 'grim pa/ snabs lud mchil ma 'thor ba sogs rang ngan pa'i gras su tshud cing bstan pa'i mig rgyan la gnod pa rnams dran shes bzhin gyi bsrung sdom dang / zhar byung tsam du zla re'i rnam rgyal gtong skabs bskul po dang chos khrims gzhon pas phyed tsam song kyang gzhan mi 'byon pa dang byon nas kyang rang gang dran las med tshul thos pas rnam rgyal kun rig sogs cho ga gang byed kyang so so'i gnas skabs su dgos pa'i rdor dril ting shag 'dzin dkrol/ phyag rgya rol chen 'bud dkrol/ dus chen mchod phreng 'khyer skabs gral gyi phreng ba ma chad par snyoms shing mtho dma' ma shor ba rten khebs dang ba dan gyi mdun ngos rang gi g.yas phyogs su bstan nas khyer ba sogs phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len rnam dag kho na las byis pa'i rtse mo lta bu'i brnyas bcos su ma song ba zhig dang / hor zla dgu pa'i bcu drug la chos mtshams btang nas nye ba rnams nyer lnga dang / ring ba rnams gnam gang bar/ gsum pa'i bcu dgur chos mtshams dang 'dus tshul dgu pa dang 'dra/ 'brog btsun gyi chos mtshams drug pa'i dgu la btang nas 'brog khag gsum tshes bco lnga la 'dus/ lhas bstan pa bcu dgu la 'dus pa bya rgyu'i 'gro skabs dang chu tshan du 'gro ba sogs lus kyi 'phrod bsten tshang mar sgo gsum gyi kun spyod rtsing hral du ma song ba'i sems 'khur gang che dang / dpyid zla dang ston zla'i chos mtshams 'dus nas dpe mtshams ring mo gzhan chos thog bdun gyi chos mtshams la'ang dpe mtshams gang lcogs byed/ phar tshur gyi mchod gnas la 'byon skabs kyang tshogs gsog ma khyer bar la bsgrigs pa'i gras yin na gsung sgrogs dang mdo sgrol sogs rim gro gang 'os bka' bcu rab 'byams pa'i gras yin na gong gi steng dkar rdor ngos bsnyen song zhig gis bum 'dzin byas phyin tshe chog kun rig sil gtor sogs chos grwa lho yi zhal 'don gyi gras gang 'os/

tshogs gsog khyer nas chos grwa byang gi sgrig lam la 'byon 'dod yod na'ang de bzhin dang / rang gang mos kyi bsnyen sgrub/ mchod gnas kyi skabs su'ang rnam 'joms sme brtsegs/ chab klu seng sgra sogs rang re'i gong ma'i bka' srol la zhugs pa'i sngags chog ci rigs dang / 'byung bzhi sogs sngags gzhung gzhan las 'byung ba'i 'gro phan gang mtshams kyis gson dge dang / phung po chas 'jug sogs rus chog dang / sbyin sreg lho sgo sāts+tsha 'debs pa/ nad par sngags chu ster ba sogs sngags gyi lag len gang byed kyang ha cang gi mngon mtshan can du ma song phyin gang la gang 'tshams so so'i skabs bstun mdzad rgyu dang / rang rang gi gling du bzhugs skabs kyang / sngar phan gling dpon la rtsis med yod tshul thos pas da cha gling dpon gyis drang po byas phyin 'khur med mi mdzad par gling dpon la yang dag par bstan pa dang / gling dpon nas kyang rang gis ma shes phar bzhag gi phan thogs bslab bya gang yong ci shes bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang chos sde'i sgrig lam/ rang gi 'di phyi'i don la bsams nas lan cig min par yang yang byed pa dang / grwa bgres zur bzhugs pa ngag rgyun bya chu rgan gog tu thogs pa rnams kyang mang jar dpe mtshams pa 'byon dgos rnams dang / tshe chog cho ga sogs phal cher rgyug rgyun gyi mang ja dang / bka' 'gyur skabs tshe chog med pa dang skal ba yod pa rnams mi rgyug sgo rig gyi sgrig grwar yang mi 'gro ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'dra zhing sgrig gtan mi rgyug pa rnams gnas skabs kun tu'ang 'du tshogs kyi rigs nas bud 'gro bas sngar srol gang yod de bzhin dang / sa rtsi gling 'debs lo gsar mtshan brjod sogs la gnas skabs kun tu 'dud longs kyi rigs shin tu 'dzem cha che nges/ ran tshod longs spyod pa las 'jig rten pa lta bu'i bag med du ma song ba zhig dang / gsung sgrogs sogs kyi zhabs yon la dngos po sna tshogs phul skabs spus bsgyur zhu ba'i mi nag yong ba bden yang /

dge 'dun la brnyas bcos lta bu'i dbu dang phrag steng sogs nas dngos po rnams bag med du len pa dang / mnyam lab dbang chen du byed pa 'di yang 'dus tshogs kyi zhabs 'dren dang / kho rang tshor nyes pa lci bas slan chad spus bsgyur zhu mi rnams dge 'dun dang 'gyangs bcad pa'i mthar mar 'dug ngos rang gang 'dod kyi dngos po 'di bzhin zhu tshul las tshan dbu yod rnams la snyan sgron dang / snga phyi mig ltos ngan pa bzhin byung na las tshan grwa bgres rnams nas bca' yig gsar pa bkod phyin 'di bzhin dgos tshul gyi bslab bya byed/ chos spyod nas bzung rab 'byams pa'i mthar thug pa 'dzin chos kyi skor la sngags 'chang chen po'i bca' yig lhan thabs sor bzhag nged rang gis tho zur gsal kha bris pa bzhin thams cad kyis thugs khur bskyed pa dang / rtsa ba'i slob gnyer pod chen drug gi bshar sbyangs la ma gnod phyin sgra snyan ngag rtsis sogs sbyang pa bya rgyu dang rang re'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa zhig gal che bas/ rgya gzhung gi gsal byed chos rje khu dbon kun mkhyen chen po/ zhwa lu lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i kā la pa'i skor dpang los mdzad pa'i snyan ngag dang mngon brjod skor/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs rang lugs bla ma tshad thub kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba rnams la sbyangs pa dang / sman 'di ni chos grwa lho yi sgrig dang 'gal tshabs che bas mi sbyong zhing / yi ge che chung 'bri shes pa du ma mchis kyang khungs chod pa dka' bas yig rigs la dag snang yod gras rnams khungs dang bstun sbyong brdar byas pa'i sum rtags kyi gsal byed kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa dang / dag yig skor 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa la yang dag par rtogs nges/ gsung rab gang bzhengs kyang brda dag sogs sgros gtsang kho na las/ deng sang lta bu'i gzugs dang dag byed gnyis ka med pa 'di mang che na/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung la lhad 'jug cing /

bstan rgyun la'ang shin tu gnod pas dpe rgyun dkon na'ang ma bris pa legs shing / sngar rgyun bzhin gyi bsod snyoms la 'byon pa sogs byung na'ang de skabs su dgos pa'i bca' yig sor bzhag mdzad ngos/ bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa zhig dang / ngam rings sogs grwa skor la 'byon skabs sku yon gyis mi bslu na'ang 'phral gyi mdzad spyod mi dang bstun gang shes tshogs gsog sogs gsung bshad mdzad rgyu rnams la'ang tshig dag cing don phigs pa'i ngag ngog tu ma song ba zhig dang / de mtshungs chos khrims pas tshogs skad 'di yang ha cang myur ches pas dge 'dun rnams the tshom gyi gzhir gyur dgos sogs nyes pa bsrung ba'i phyir dal brel snyoms shing sgra don dag pa zhig zer lugs dang / dpyad khra sgrog skabs su yin kyang dal bus go don myong zhing bklags la thams cad kyi snyan du lhon pa zhig byed pa dang / rab 'byams pa bgres grwa rnams rten bshad la phebs skabs/ gnas rten ngo sprad tsam ma yin par mus srad pa'i dkar chag mkhas dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rten bshad/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis 'phro mthud mdzad pa rnams la gzigs rtogs mthil phyin mdzad na 'thus sam snyam zhing / gal te ma 'thus tshe nged rang nas longs skabs byung na sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po btab pa nas bzung deng sang yan gyi gnas rten tshang ma la bshad pa khungs thub zhig rtsom 'dun yod pas/ slar de sogs la zhib 'jug mdzad ngos/ mjal mi rnams dwang ba 'dren pa'i bshad pa mdzad dgos so/ /mdor na bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa ni rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi 'byung khungs gdan sa chen po 'di nyid la thug pa'i mkhas grub bshes gnyen grangs med byon nas bod gangs can gyis mtshon sems can thams cad la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde stsol ba zhig byung na ci ma rung dgongs pa kho na yin pa ni kun gyi thugs la mnga' ba ltar lags pas/

de dag gi rjes 'jug rang cag tshang mas gong ma rnams kyi dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i spang blang byung na dal 'byor gyi mi lus stong log tu mi 'gro ba sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde 'bad med du 'byung la/ de ltar ma yin na spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs so lo dang / bye brag rje btsun gong mar dad pa yod skad kyi tshig skam tsam las/ don la bstan 'gro gang sar bsam med byas pa kho nar song ba gzu bor gnas pa'i blos dpyad na shin tu gsal bas/ gang 'khod bca' yig 'di la nan tan snying por mdzad ngos/ slar yang yang zhu mi dgos pa zhig da nas bzung ji srid chos grwa 'di gnas kyi bar 'dir bzhugs rim can tshang mas thugs 'jags zhu zhing / bu dang slob ma sogs mi dge ba'i lam las ldog pa'i phyir zhi drag gi bslab bya bya dgos la/ snying nas byams pa spangs ba'i zhe gnag can ni ma yin te/ mkhas dbang dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ gdug la byams pa spongs zhes gang gsungs pa/ /pha rol ngan spyod byed las ldog phyir te/ /snying nas byams pa spong ba theg mchog gi /rtsa ltung bzhi par rgyud gzhung kun las gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyis rtogs nus shing / ngan spyod can la snying rje bsgoms pa ma dag pa'i snying rje yin tshul sdom gsum rab dbye sogs bstan bcos tshad ldan las 'byung bas na/ dge rgan so sos btsun chung gi mtshon rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i slob ma rgan gzhon tshang ma la legs slob nyes spyod 'jur gang dam dang / chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi sgrig gnon du mkhan rin po che/ spyi chen/ dbu byed las thog pa rnams nam lcogs bar dang / chos khrims pa re mos zla ba drug pa re bla ma gong ma rim can gyis bsko bzhag mdzad pa ltar/ khyed las tshan tshang ma blo rtse gcig tu sgril mkhan rin po che nas mi 'os pa'i bka' bkod mdzad don mi 'dug pas bka' gang gnang dang /

gsung ci 'grub las tshan 'og ma rnams kyis mtshon tshang mas mdzad dgos shing / gal te mkhan chen nyid kyis thugs blos ma chod pa byung tshe las tshan rnams la bka' 'dri dang / de bstun las sne rnams nas kyang rang gis gang shes kyi drang gtam 'khyog po'i tshig ma yin par bden pa'i ngag gis zhu ba dang / de dag gis kyang ma 'thus tshe/ mgron gnyer/ mdzod pa sogs brgyud de nged rang la gnas tshul zer ba'am/ yang na mkhan chen sku dngos kyis gsungs kyang chog pas gang ltar da lam bris pa'i yi ge le tshan 'di dag snag shog gzan pa dang / byin rlabs gyi rten tsam du ma lus par rjes gnon rim pa can du gtong rgyu yin pas so sos dgongs 'jags zhu/ rdul 'dres lcags phye khab len rdo yis len par nus kyi rdo phal gzhan gyis de ltar min/ /chos kun blang dor mkhas pa dag gis bya bar nus kyi blun po rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /de 'dra'i mkhas pa mdo rgyud pha rol phyin la 'byung gi rang gar gnas la ci nas 'byung / /de ltar bas na blo ldan rnams ni legs par gson dang thos bsam nan tan bya bar rigs/ /kye ma 'jig rten pa dag dran tsam nas/ /snang ba ma nub bar du sdig la spyod/ /gtan du 'dod pa bsgrubs kyang mi 'dod pa/ /kho na myong zhing byas tshad dam chos dang / /'gal bas 'di phyi kun tu ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'di la blo ldan su zhig smon par byed/ /kye hud gzhon dus bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /lus stobs rgyas nas nyon mongs dug lngas g.yeng / /dad rdzas za la nongs med ham can rnams/ /phyi ma'i 'dug gnas dmyal ba las gzhan gang / /deng sang rab byung la la btsos myos kyi/ /chang la bag med spyod cing gzhan la'ang ster/ /bsrung sdom tshul bzhin byed la blo chung zhes/ /smra ba de nyid phyi ma me 'bar ba'i/ /khro chu 'thung dgos 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na tshe 'dir skom pas rab gdungs kyang /

/sel byed chang ma yin pas thabs mang phyir/ /phyi ma'i khro chu soms dang spong bar rigs/ /kye ma snyigs dus thos bsam byed blo rnams/ /bstan 'gro bsam pa'i mthar phyin mi byed par/ /rang la rab 'byams pa zhes ming snyan zhig /gzhan sgrog tshig la zhen pa 'di nyid kyang / /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin snyam bdag dogs so/ /rab tu 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rab mang dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /rab bzang sde snod bshar sbyangs phul phyin gyis/ /rab 'byams chos sgra sgrog 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /tshogs gnyis legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'dus sde rnams/ /'on kyang 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun phal che bas/ /sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar ma mthong zhing / /mthong yang yongs 'dzin mkhas dang ma 'phrad pas/ /bstan la phan zhing rang gzhan dus kun tu/ /bde ba sgrub 'dod 'di ni srid pa tsam/ /de phyir bdag gis bstan dang rang gzhan la/ /phan phyir snying gtam mdor bsdus zhu yis gson/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyi zhabs bsten te/ /thog mar 'bri klog chos spyod byang chub cing / /bar du pod chen drug la sbyangs mthar phyin/ /rig pa'i gnas gzhan la'ang goms byas nas/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan par bya/ /de rjes rang nyid 'bad pas nyams len zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo phyogs med rab bskor te/ /brgyud 'dzin bshes gnyen skar phran ltar mang bas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab byas nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde dbyar mtsho ltar/ /rgya cher spel la rang gzhan don gnyis mdzod/ /dge legs kun 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel chos srung nor lha yis/ /'dir bzhugs 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen mdzod/ /ces chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i dge 'dun rnams la sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa'i bca' yig ngo mtshar nying khu nyes sel legs spel gyi sman 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba 'di yang nged rang la rtsom 'dun yod khar 'phral gyi bskul ma mkhan rin po che chos bkra shis nas sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa'i bca' yig cig rtsom dgos zhes dngos brgyud du bskul ma mdzad don ltar sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mi shes shes brdzu dang rtag 'dzin snyoms las la yon tan du byed pa gang des/

bla ma gong ma gsum gyi gsung gi nying khu bsdus shing / legs slob nyes 'chos lhag bsam rnam dag rang sems la gang shar thams cad sba gsang med par bkod pa 'di yang 'dus tshogs rnams dgyes kyang rung ste rang gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus 'bad pa med par ngang gis sgrig lam kun spyod tshang ma la nyes bral dge legs kyi rgya mtsho rdol ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha bodhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ lha mi'i ston mchog ston mchog gang gi bstan pa 'phags yul rgyas mdzad mdzad po paṇa grub ji snyed dang / /bod yul gangs ljongs gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya'i bla chen chen po yab sras khu dbon dang / /gnas lnga kun mkhyen kun mkhyen mchog gyur sa skya paṇa chen paṇa chen rjes 'brangs mdo rgyud 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /sa skya lo tsā lo tsā bai ro'i rnam 'phrul sngags 'chang yab sras sras mchog rim byon kun la 'dud/ /zhes rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba btab nas/ 'dir chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi thog mar 'bri klog nas brtsams chos spyod dang sde snod kyi bshar sbyangs/ zhar byung sngags chog phran bu bcas thos bsam gnang dgos kyi tho zur gsal bkod na/ de la spyir snyigs dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dang mkhas pa snga mas sbyar ba'i ring lugs rnam dag 'dzin pa dkon tshul ni/ sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu las/ dge sbyong phal cher thos pa nyung / /sdom brtson phal cher bkur ba nyung / /bkur ba de dag sdom brtson nyung / /sbyin bdag chos la dad pa nyung / /dad pa can gyi mchod bya dman/ /mchod pa de dag log 'tsho'i rgyu/ /gal te log 'tsho mi za ba'i/ /chos byed de dag dman dman 'dra/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dad na yang / /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab ngo mtshar can/

/de dag bzhi mdo'i rtsa bzhin dor/ /blun po rnams kyi rdzun tshig la/ /thub pa'i bka' bzhin gus par 'dzin/ /bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub dang / /thogs med dang ni dbyig gi gnyen/ /phyogs kyi glang po chos grags sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /'phags pa lha sogs grub thob kyi/ /gsung rab yin par nges pa rnams/ /dug bzhin 'bad pas spangs nas ni/ /zhes pa nas/ khyed kyi gsung (rab )'dzin pa dkon/ zhes gsungs pas na/ 'phags yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sde snod dang rgyud sde'i don la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon par gsungs shing / de la brten nas yang dag pa'i bstan pa dang 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' gang yin ngo mi shes pas chos par khas blangs kyang bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa ni u dum wā ra'i me tog las kyang dkon pas/ des na bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la snying nas dad pa thob cing / rang gzhan legs 'dod kyi blo bcos min yod pa rnams kyis thos bsam la nan tan bya bar rigs te/ byams mgon gyis/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ sgra tshad sogs rig gnas phyi ma rnams kyi tshig don gyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ nang rig gi yang dag pa'i lam la sbyar te 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de ltar thos bsam byas pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las/ dus zhing rab tu zhi bas spobs pa bskyed/ /grags pa chen po 'phral du 'byung bar byed/ /smra lce bde 'gyur khyad par can gyi rgyu/ /thos pas dpal goms don gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ /thos dang ldan na 'gal ba med pa yin/ /sde snod gsum la rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /

thos bsam byas na mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba/ sbyin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ gang la phan phyir nga yi chos/ /tshul bzhin bstan pas mchod 'gyur gyi/ /me tog byug pa mar me yis/ /rgyal ba yang dag mchod ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang / gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ gang gis gaṅgā'i ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing / /rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang byas nas/ /rab dga'i sems kyis rgyal la 'bul ba dang / /gang gis sems can gcig la tshigs bcad byin/ /rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya che dpe/ /tshigs bcad sbyin pa snying rjes sgrub de la/ /char yang mi phod grangs su'ang ma yin na/ /gnyis dang gsum du bsam du ga la yod/ /ces sogs dang / gsum pa ni/ bslab btus las/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bstan pa'i mdo las/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /mthar ma phyin par gyur ba lags/ /zhes dang / sdom gsum las/ mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /mthun pa'i thos bsam bsgom pa ni/ /bsam pa dag pas sgrub byed na/ /sangs rgyas bstan par shes par bya/ /zhes sogs bka' dang bstan bcos du ma nas rgya cher gsungs pa ltar/ thos bsam bsgom gsum la nan tan du bya dgos pa las/ thog mar mkhan slob kyi drung du rab byung gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhus te/ chos kyi ma mo dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge gug skyed/ 'greng bu/ na ro/ brtsegs ma/ 'dogs can/ yig log mthug po sogs rnam dbye shin tu mtha' chod cing zhib par slob dgos pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos byis pa bde 'jug tu ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin nges par byas/ de dang chabs cig chos spyod ngag slob kyi mgo bzung / yi ge sbyar klog dang bsdus nas shin tu dag par sgrog thub tshe chos spyod kyi 'phro 'dzin chos su'ang sprad de/

btsun gsar byas nas lo gcig khongs su chos spyod rab gsal tshang ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bca' yig na btsun gsar byas nas zla ba bdun gyi khongs su chos spyod tshang ma dgos tshul gnang 'dug kyang / de nas dus kyis chos spyod 'phar stobs shin tu che bas nged rang gis bca' yig gsar sgrigs na lo gcig khongs la chos spyod dang bka' bzhi'i rjes su bsdus gzhung sprod dgos bris yod kyang btsun chung blo rmongs dang na phra rnams nas shin tu 'grub dka' bas/ da phyin blo gros kyis 'chun tshe bca' yig sngon bkod sor bzhag dang / de min lo gnyis khongs su chos spyod dang / bka' bzhi dbu ma mdzod gzhung sogs rgyugs sprod kha shas song nas bsdus dpe sprad kyang 'gal ba mi 'dug pas go rim ci ltar kyang dngos gzhi rgyugs sprod tshang ma byed dgos/ 'gril bar bya/ de'i rjes su bka' bzhi/ de nas bsdus gzhung chos rnam pas mdzad pa rigs pa'i gter mdzod/ de nas btsun chung dbang po yang rab rnams kyi dbu ma mdzod gzhung / rnam 'grel gyi gzhung ngam/ byams chos lnga go rim nges med kyi gnyis char/ mdo rtsa/ mngon pa kun btus sogs grangs chen bco brgyad rim gyis rgyugs 'bul byed/ dbang 'bring dang / dbang rtul rnams kyis gong 'khod de nas shes rab kyis ci lcogs rgyugs 'bul byed/ de rjes rim gyis bsdus ra sogs la rnam dpyod kyi rtsal thon nas sgrig la thebs skabs kun rig dang rnam rgyal sogs cho ga'i rigs 'pher nges dang / lag bde'i rgyugs la phar phyin pa yin tshe phar phyin dka' 'grel par ma 'di'i mgo nas bzung lhag ma rnams kyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar shog grangs lnga bcu nga gcig tshad ma ba yin tshe rigs gter gsal byed/ rtags rig tshang ma dang / blo rigs nas rab dbye dang po yan/ de nas phar phyin pa yin na dka' 'grel/ yum don rab gsal/

yan lag rgyas bshad sogs go rams bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bka' 'bum nas 'byung ba'i phar phyin skor gyi yig cha rnams dang / rang ṭīka sogs rang lugs tshad ldan gyi yig cha rnams rgyugs 'bul ci nus byed/ tshad ma ba yin na rigs gter rang 'grel/ rigs gter gsal byed/ sde bdun rab gsal/ ṭīk+ka che chung sogs sa paṇa dang kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum gras rnams dang / gzhan yang sa lugs tshad thub kyi yig cha tshad ma la mkho ba rnams rim gyis rgyugs 'bul byed/ de nas bka' bcur khyon nas tshe chog dang gtor ma sogs 'pher nges dang / tshad ma ba yin na phar phyin dka' 'grel par ma bcu gsum pa'i rgyab logs yig phreng gsum pa'i/ gsum pa gnad kyi don ngos bzung ba la gsum ste zer ba nas so gsum pa'i rgyab logs yig phreng bdun pa'i mjug mya ngan 'das la skyabs su 'gro zhes so/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / phar phyin pa yin na rigs gter gsal byed rtags rig gi mgo nas rab dbye bcu gcig pa'i rigs sgor niṣ+ṭa yan lag yin pas de gcod nus so/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / sdom gsum kha skong / bdud rtsi snying khu sogs sdom gsum rab dbye dang rjes 'brel gyi yig cha rnams la rgyugs 'bul dang lta rtogs ci nus byas nas phar phyin pa yin na tshad ma la lo gcig tshad ma ba yin na phar phyin la lo gcig ring la bshar sbyang bya/ de nas mngon pa la lo gcig 'dul ba la lo gcig dbu ma la lo gcig sdom gsum la lo gcig brtsis nas rab 'byams grwa skor skabs gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du sngon gyi yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams pu ti brgya kha yar ba la dam bca'/ 'bring grags chen bco brgyad la dam bca'/ tha mas pod chen drug dang rigs gter la dam bca'/ grags chen bco brgyad la sbyor bkod/ pod chen drug la bshad pa yang dag par byas nas chos khrims par slebs skabs bstan pa gso chog gi rgyugs dang / chos sde'i sgrig lam kun spyod tshang mar 'jig rten ngo bsrung /

dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / ya yo 'khyag 'khyog tu ma song bar rab 'byams pa bgres grwa nas bzung btsun gsar yan dang / mang ja 'byon pa'i bde chen gling pa/ chos lhun pa sogs khyams stod du 'tshogs 'os tshang ma dang / btsun ma/ sngags bon/ drug cu mthil pa/ ja dpon/ sbud 'bud/ lag bde ba sogs mdor na gnas skabs su gcur dgos tshang mar sgrigs gcur gang dam ha cang gis drag pa dang zhan par ma song ba thabs mkhas kyis 'jur dag bya dgos shing / de nas drug pa tshes bzhi sogs kyi bshad par rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod/ sngags 'chang chen po'i rnam thar/ pod chen drug gi 'grel pa sogs rang gang mos nas bshad pa 'bul ba dang / bshad gsog tshogs gsog skabs dam bca' rab 'byams grwa bskor bzhin dang / bshad gsog pa'i sbyor ba ni nyin rer gzhung re la re res 'thus shing / de nas rim gyis ngam rings grwa bskor/ gzhi len rgyun rgyugs dang / bsnyen rdzogs las grwa/ sne bshan par 'byon pa sogs gnas skabs kun tu gang la gang dgos tshang mar khral 'jal tsam ma yin pa'i theg pa khur blangs bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa zhig bya dgos shing / bka' bcu sgrig pa/ btsun chung sogs dbyar chos dgun chos la bshad pa byed skabs gzhung so sor sbyor ba re/ bka' bzhi pa yin na/ nyin gsum char la rigs gter/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ sdom gsum rnams la sbyor ba re dang / nyin bar mar so thar la gcig ste bcu/ byams chos pa rnams kyis sde lnga la re re bya/ gzhan yang gong du ma 'thus pa'i rgyugs sprod kyi skor/ chos rje khu dbon/ g.yag rong rnam gnyis/ kun mkhyen chen po ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ chos rnam rgyal sogs mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyu'i theg pa la mkho ba'i yig cha rnams gang lcogs rgyugs 'bul lta rtogs sogs byas ngos rab 'byams pa'i mthar thug par gyur tshe/ rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum sogs bla ma gong ma mang po'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba'i sngags phyogs kyi skor la'ang thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs yang dag par chod pa dang /

rab 'byams kyi mthar thug par ma gyur bar sngags kyi nyams len sogs gtan nas mi mdzad cing / gal te tshe mthar ma phyin par thos pa byed mu nas dus las yol ba zhig byung nas sngags phyogs kyi nyams len med tshe 'khor bar mi 'khyams pa'i mtshams sbyor mi 'byung ngam snyam pa'i dgos pa yod na'ang / sa lo chen pos/ zab mo'i lam mchog bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /g.yel ba med par rtse gcig sgom par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ zab lam gyi yang rtse bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ni btsun chung nas bzung chag med lta bur bton pa yin pas mtshan nyid theg pa la sbyangs pa mthar phyin byed skabs sngags phyogs kyi nyams len thams cad gcig chog rgyal po 'dir bsdus nas paṇ+ḍi tas dpyad sgom du bsgoms pas des rgyun gyi bar do'i 'jigs skrag sogs snang ba rnams 'khrul par rtogs nas 'khor ba las skyob pa'i mtshams sbyor cis kyang yong bas de bzhin dang / zhar byung kun rig tshe chog rnam rgyal/ bstan pa gso chog sil gtor sogs sngags la gtogs pa 'di dag la'ang brnyas chos ma yin pa'i sbyang pa byas ngos/ de dang de'i skabs su rang gzhan dang ba 'gro ba zhig dge 'dun tshang ma nas dgongs 'jag zhu/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs rje dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /chos grwa 'di nyid dar rgyas rtag brtan cing / /srid zhi'i dge legs 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces nged rang nas brtsams pa'i bca' yig yan lag las thub bstan lha chen pa rnams kyis 'dzin chos sogs ji ltar mdzad tshul gyi tho 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /swasti/ thub bstan lha khang chen mor gong ma lnga'i gsung mkho che ba ni/ sa chen gyis/ bir bstod lhan skyes spros bral ma/ zhang bstod yon tan mchog mnga' ma/ slob dpon rin po ches/

sa chen gyi sku bstod tshangs dbang ma/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde 'jug spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rtse mo'i bstod pa khyod nyid ma/ sgrol ma 'don thabs/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum/ 'khor lo/ chos spyod rin chen 'phreng ba/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i bshad pa/ spyod 'jug bsdus don/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs gang drin ma/ bir bstod dad chu ma/ rje btsun gyi bstod pa yon tan rgya mtsho ma/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ legs bshad/ skyes bu rnams la dri ba'i tshul/ mkhas 'jug byis pa bde 'jug gi rnam bshad/ nga brgyad rtsa 'grel/ rigs gter rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga de'i lung sbyor/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ sangs rgyas 'phrin zhu/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la springs yig lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par byed dgos tshul/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag sdud pa sogs mdo 'don thabs/ ltung bshags 'don thabs/ bsngo ba'i yon bshad/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ lam 'bras phyag mchod/ sa paṇa gyi rnam thar bstod pa/ gsol 'debs phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ thogs med sku mched sogs la bstod pa/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshul/ ri khrod ma'i bstod pa/ shes bya rab gsal/ rgyud bla'i bsdus don/ theg chen slob dpon dang / slob mas nyams su blang tshul gyi rnam dbye bstan pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus gnyis bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga rnams so/ /g.yag pas/ phar phyin la ṭīk+ka rin chen phreng ba/ 'bring po rin chen bang mdzod/ chung ba rin chen bsam 'phel rnams dang / tshad ma la rnam 'grel gyi ṭik+ka yid kyi mun sel/ rig gter gyi ṭīk+ka 'od stong 'phro ba/ rong ston gyis/ phar phyin dang tshad ma la ṭīk+ka re sogs gzhung bzhi bcu zhe gsum la ṭīk+ka mdzad par grags so/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges/ phar phyin brgyud 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa khyad par 'phags pa'i 'od zer tshad ma brgyud 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa rmad du byung ba'i 'od zer/

khro phu byams chen la mtshan lam du bstod pa byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ma/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs dus bstod pa grub pa'i 'dod 'jo/ tshad ma brgyud pa la mchod pa tshig rgyan yid 'phrog 'phyang ba'i mgul rgyan/ phar phyin brgyud pa la mchod pa tshig rgyan rmad byung dbyangs can dga' ba'i gtam/ rtags 'jug gi ṭīk+ka/ phar phyin spyi don yum don rab gsal/ dngos brgyad don bdun cu'i rnam gzhag zhib tu ston pa sbas don rab gsal/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i ngag 'don gyi sbyor ba go bde bar bkod pa sbyor ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dka' ba'i gnad rnam par bshad pa sbas don zab mo gter gyi kha 'byed dam da lta phar phyin dka' 'grel du grags pa/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam gzhag skyes bu mchog gi gsal byed/ bsam gzugs/ 'gog snyoms/ thod rgal rnams kyi rnam gzhag snyoms 'jug rab gsal/ rten 'brel spyi don 'khor 'das rab bsal/ rgyud bla ma'i ṭīk+ka rtsom 'phro/ tshad ma'i spyi don rgyas pa sde bdun rab gsal/ bsdus pa rigs gter gsal byed/ ṭīk+ka rgyas pa kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer/ sbyor ṭīka kun bzang nyi ma/ rnam 'grel bsdus don rgyas pa/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i sa bcad rgyas pa/ spyi don 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po/ mngon pa 'og ma la mdzod kyi spyi don ngo mtshar gsum ldan rtsom 'phro/ gong ma la phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par ston pa de nyid shes bya'i sgo 'byed dbu ma'i spyi don stong thun chen mo nges don rab gsal/ stong thun chung ba theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer/ 'jug 'grel lta ba ngan sel/ dbu ma rtsa 'grel rtsom 'phro rin chen phreng ba/ bzhi brgya pa/ snying po kun btus/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel/ byang chub sems 'grel rnams la bsdus don zhib pa re/ sdom gsum 'khrul spong / sdom gsum spyi don/ sdom gsum sa bcad rgyas pa/

sdom ṭīka gsung rab dgongs gsal/ kha skong gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed/ bdud rtsi'i nying khu rtsa 'grel rnams so/ /paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ phar phyin spyi don/ chos 'khor gyi bshad pa lung gi sgron me/ rgyud bla'i ṭīk+ka/ brgyad stong pa dang sdud pa gnyis mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lugs khungs su sbyar ba/ bzang spyod kyi ṭīk+ka/ rnam 'grel gyi gzhan don ṭīk+ka/ tshad ma'i spyi don/ tshad ma'i khog phub/ 'dul ba'i spyi don/ mngon pa mdzod kyi spyi don/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i spyi don/ bshes spring gi rnam bshad/ thal rang gi shan 'byed/ rtags chen lnga yi rnam gzhag sdom gsum ṭīka chen/ sdom gsum spyi don/ sa lam 'phros pa'i 'bras bu gnyis kyi dogs dpyod/ sdom gsum kha skong gi ṭīk+ka/ mkhas 'jug gi rnam bshad/ gzhung chen drug gi 'brel gtam/ 'brel gtam gyi brgal len/ 'brel gtam rin chen mdzes pa'i phra tshom rnams/ mkhas dbang chos rnam rgyal gyis/ mchod brjod kyi rim pa/ bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gnyis/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag gzhung lugs spyi bshad/ dam bca'i sngon 'gro/ chos 'khor gyi bshad pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi mtha' dpyad/ rnam mkhyen gyi mtha' dpyad/ rtogs pa'i rnam gzhag rigs kyi skabs/ bden gnyis bden bzhi spyan sogs rnam gzhag sgrub pa'i dmigs pa sogs kyi mtha' dpyad/ skabs gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ brgyad pa rnams kyi mtha' dpyad/ dka' 'grel dgongs rgyan lung rigs chu gter rnams dang / nyer mkho blo sbyong brgyud 'debs dang / phar phyin brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong gnyis/ rigs gter gyi bshad pa blo gsal smra ba'i rgyan/ sde bdun dgongs rgyan/ dka' gnas gtan la 'bebs pa rtags skor/ bsdus gzhung 'dod 'jo'i ba/ so thar rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ sdom gsum gyi dka' gnas gsed bkrol dgongs rgyan/ rnam bshad dgongs gsal nyi 'od/

skabs gnyis pa'i gzhung don mtha' dpyad mgrin pa'i rgyan/ skabs gsum kar gyi mtha' dpyad/ tshig don rags par bshad pa/ skabs gsum pa'i dka' 'grel/ skabs gsum pa'i mtha' dpyad rdo rje'i phreng ba/ bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal/ 'bras bu'i dogs dpyod mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed me long / sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i brgal lan drang thig gnam lcags thog gi 'khor lo dang / yang len bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rmongs mun gsal byed/ yang len bdud rtsi'i thig pa la rtsod spong pha lam rdo rje'i tho ba/ lung rigs bang mdzod/ mdzad bcu'i bshad pa dpyod ldan rol mtsho/ mdo rtsa'i gzhung 'grel 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i bcud las chog lhan thabs rin chen phreng mdzes/ bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen so sor 'bog chog yang bslab tshigs dang po 'bogs chog bsrung sdom ston pa ltung ba sde lnga'i rnam gzhag zhu ba las gsungs pa'i ltung ba spyir bstan gyi dka' gnas la dpyad pa/ gso sbyong dbyar gnas dgag dbye gzhi gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'dul 'dzin yongs la nye bar mkho ba dang / yang mtha' dpyad zin bris rol mtsho/ khrid gsum bca' ba'i yi ge dpag bsam ljon shing / mdzod kyi dka' gnas dbyig gnyen dgongs rgyan rnam bzhi rnams/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis/ rje btsun chos rje khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa'i rgya gzhung rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa/ phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi rjes su sbyar rgyu/ dge bsnyen sgrub chog dge bsnyen dang dge tshul sgrub chog gaṇ+ḍe'i rnam gzhag grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag ston pas cho 'phrul bstan tshul/ bzang spyod khog phub/ smon lam lung sbyor/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long gi don 'grel/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa 'chad thabs/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel/

blang dor gsal ba'i me long / tshe mdo'i rnam bshad rnams// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ chos spyod mkha' la bsgrigs rim sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ /mdzad byang mtshams sbyor klog 'phreng rnam par 'khyug /byin rlabs zab ma'i 'brug stong di ri ri/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis char zim dal gyis 'bab/ /de slad phyogs gzhan rab rib dang bral zhing / /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i mig ldan skye bo yis/ /tshul bzhin bltas na yang dag lam bzang gi /snang ba gsal bar 'gyur zhes kho bos sgrog /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor 'dzin ma yangs pa ma/ /thos bsam sgom pas byi dor legs byas te/ /thar pa'i grong khyer 'gro 'dod blo yod na/ /chos spyod bsgrigs rim 'di la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge'i gsung dri ma med pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mor bzhugs pa'i 'dus tshogs rnams nas chos spyod gsung sgrog gsung chog gi rim pa ji ltar mdzad tshul gyi thog dbu byed rim can nas mi brjed dran pa'i gsal 'debs su 'dzin dgos la/ thug tshul gyi dus skyabs 'gro bzhi skor tshar gsum sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs ma tshar gsum/ rnam dag chos dbyings sogs spyan 'dren nas bzhugs gsol gyi bar gdangs ma/ gnas brtan phyag mchod/ chos gtor ma byung gong la sgrol ma tshar gcig byung na tshar gsum/ 'chi med dpal sbyin ma rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring tshar gcig 'dod gsol/ dkar cha bzhi bar do bcas/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ sems brtse ma gdangs bcas/ yon sbyong gi gzungs/ smon lam tshigs bcad dang bcas/ chos gtor ma byung gong la sher snying bdud bzlog tshar gsum byung nas tshar gcig bcas/ byams smon tshar gcig mjug gi shis brjod rnams dbu byed nas 'os 'tsham/ ༈ gung tshigs la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzhugs su gsol gyi bar gong bzhin/ de nas sgrol bstod/

phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun/ 'dod gsol bcas/ dkon mchog rjes dran man chad thug tshul dang 'dra/ sngags 'chang chen po'i bca' yig na 'di nang bzhin 'dug kyang / lag len la chos gtor ma byung gong / dge 'dun byings tshogs nas sgrol ma tshar lnga/ chos gtor byung nas snga dro'i chos grwa grol rjes btsun chung rnams tshogs nas bsdus ra skyor 'go bas bskul ba'i sgrol ma tshar bdun gyi drug la gdangs thung dang / bdun pa oṃ rje btsun ma sogs bzhag nas/ phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo nas gdangs ring dang bcas so sor 'joms gyur cig gi bar dang / byang phyogs skyong ba'i dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma la'ang gdangs gong bzhin byas grol nas chos grwa gnyis pa dang gsum pa mdzad tshul 'dug kyang / slan chad chos gtor ma byung bar gung tshigs byung na gong bkod sor bzhag dang / byung nas chos grwa dang po grol rjes gung tshigs kyi chos spyod rnams bya/ de nas chos grwa gnyis pa la/ mkhan rin po che nas rgyal ba'i bka' mdo sde dang 'dul ba'i skor ram/ rgya gzhung gtso che ba grags chen bco brgyad sogs kyi skor ram/ bod gzhung rigs gter rang 'grel sogs rgyu'i theg pa la mkho ba rnams ljags lung gnang skabs chos grwar dge 'dun tshogs nas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ po tā la yi gnas mchog nas zhes sogs sgrol bstod yongs rdzogs 'dod gsol bkra shis kyi bar tshar gcig mdo tshar gcig bdud bzlog gsum/ mjug gi tshigs bcad rnams dang bcas/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po la dam pa'i chos zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang sogs sbyar/ de nas mkhan rin po ches sems bskyed gsal btab ste ljags lung de shog bu mda' tshad ma lta bu yin na bcu gsum dang /

gzhan de dod pher ba tsam zhig gnang rjes/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ bdag gis dus gsum sogs mdzad nas grol/ chos grwa gsum pa snga dro'i 'phros nas gnang tshul snga dro sor bzhag mdzad/ dgong thun dus skyabs sems gong bzhin/ ma lus sems can sh+lau ka gcig shur ma/ lha dang lha min nas/ rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog gi bar/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar nyer lnga/ phan yon brjod pa dang / 'dod gsol bcas kyi chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol gyi rjes su/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi sogs/ bla ma sku khams sogs/ sku bsod ri bo sogs/ de nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs/ a la la ste ma/ rigs rus cho 'brang ma sh+lau ka gnyis/ tshangs dbang ma/ khyod nyid ma dang tshangs spyod ma gnyis re mos/ 'di bar dbu mdzad bzhugs nas bskul/ de nas bzhengs la bde gshegs bstan pa'i sogs/ srid bral ma la gdangs mdzad/ chos rnams ma nyer gcig de nas 'phags bstod kyi bar tshang ma/ grags ldan ma/ bsod ye ma/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gangs ri ma/ mang thos nags tshal ma/ rgya chen ma/ rab mdzes ma nyer gcig zhabs drung ngag pa/ tshe nas/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ zhabs drung ngag gi dbang po mkhan chen gyi bstod pa rgyal sras ngag dbang ma/ shes bya kun la ma sh+lau ka dang po bdun/ yongs rdzogs tshar gcig gdangs bcas/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma yongs rdzogs/ chos char 'bebs gyur cig gi bar/ de rnams las bstod pa phyi ma rnams mi gtong bar skye ba kun tu sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs dbu byed kyis 'os 'tsham bsdus tsam zhig rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring gsum/ tshe gzungs gsum/ durga gsum gyi rjes su dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yi dam lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas sogs/ de nas ri khrod ma'i mngon rtogs skyabs 'gro nas bzung yongs rdzogs byas la pi shā tsi nyer gcig sher snying tshar gsum bdud bzlog mjug gi tshigs bcad bcas/

byams smon tshar gcig 'gro la bde skyid ma shur ma/ smon lam bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad nyung tsam gyi mtha' rten bcas/ tshogs gyes dus pi shā tsi 'ur 'don/ chos gtor byung rjes rgyan yig bsgrags tshun rig lung mdzad/ chos gtor la sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sngon 'gro'i gang bstod shur ma cha tshang / mkhan bstod rdzogs nas yon tan tshad med ma/ byang phyogs skyob pa'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ gtor ma dngos gzhi mdzad tshul ni/ chos khrims gzhon pas thog mar rgyal ba gnyis pa ma tshugs 'phral la gtor theb lnga tshar la bshal chu legs par btang la/ de nas gtor theb lnga tshar chu gtsang bkang la/ dge 'dun rnams kyis/ kun nas dge ba bzang po gsungs pa'i tshe/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du mchod yon dang zhal zas sogs la bsang sbyang byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul ba zhu zer/ de nas nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig gsungs pa'i tshe/ thal mo snying kar sbyar nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bskyed chog gnang ba zhu/ yang de nas/ spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo gsungs pa'i tshe/ gtor theb dang por chu blugs te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mchod sbyin gnang ba zhu/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mchod sbyin gnang ba zhu/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po'iྎ ye shes skar mda'iྎ gtor theb phyi ma la chab/ gtor theb dang po la dzam ser sku dang / gsum pa la dzam nag sku bcug gtor theb gnyis pa dang bzhi par dzam bshos gnyis po bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe/ gnyis pa'i dzam bshos la chu bran la dzam bha la ser po'i bskyed chog gnang ba zhu/ de nas dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā gsungs pa'i tshe/ ser po'i sku la chu bran te/ dzam chu 'bul ba zhu/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsungs pa'i tshe/ dzam gtor dang po la chu bran te/ dzam bshos 'bul ba zhu/ de bzhin dzam bha la nag po la'ang oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe/

gtor theb gnyis pa'i dzam bshos la chu bran/ dzam bha la nag po'i bskyed chog gnang ba zhu/ de nas dzam luṃ swāhā gsungs pa'i tshe/ nag po'i sku la chu bran la/ dzam chu 'bul ba zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsungs pa'i tshe/ dzam bshos 'bul ba zhu/ de nas dzam bha la rat+na sid+dhi pha la hoḥgasungs pa'i tshe/ dzam chu gnyis po bsres te dngos grub kyi tshul du blangs te 'thung / nag po'i bskyed chog gi sgang la gtor theb lnga par/ chu gtsang gi khar zan ril btab cing bzhag oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe de la chu bran la/ gzhi bdag gtor ma la chab zer/ de skabs gong gi dzam chu gnyis po bsdus nas tshogs khror blugs/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gsungs pa'i tshe thal mo sbyar te/ grub ste smon lam gnang ba zhu zer ba dang po yin/ bshal chu gtang dgos/ de nas gtor theb lnga tshar du zan ril blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe/ gtor theb dang po nas rim pas chu blugs/ gtor ma stong tshar bshams pa'i dang po la chab/ zhes pa nas/ bcu pa la chab zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gsungs pa'i tshe/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ grub ste smon lam gnang ba zhu zer ba dang / de rnams gso ba yin/ de 'dra ba tshar bcu byed/ de nas bshal chu btang / de nas gtor theb lnga tshar du zan ril blugs la sangs rgyas chos dang gsungs pa'i tshe/ gtor theb dang por chu blugs te gtor ma brgya rtsa bshams pa'i dang po la chab/ de nas sa pā ri gsungs pa'i tshe/ thal mo sbyar la grub ste smon lam gnang ba zhu/ de nas yang sangs rgyas chos gsungs pa'i tshe gtor ma brgya rtsa bshams pa'i gnyis pa la chab zer/ sa pā ri gsungs pa'i tshe/ grub ste smon lam gnang ba zhu/ gsum pa bzhi pa la'ang rigs 'gre bas shes par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe/ gtor theb lnga pa sbyangs la/ gtor ma brgya rtsa bshams pa'i lnga pa la chab/ lnga pa bsngo tshe dang po dang bzhi pa la bshal chu btang / zan ril blugs/

de nas drug pa nas bcu pa'i bar dang po nas rim bzhin sbyong ba sogs rigs 'gre'o/ /drug pa bsngo tshe lnga pa yang pho/ bcu pa bsngo tshe yang mgo ma bzhin bya'o/ /bshal chu btang / bcu gcig pa gtor theb dang po gsum gang rigs cig tu bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra gsungs pa'i tshe/ gong bzhin bcu gcig pa la bya zer/ bcu gcig pa la bsngo tshe/ gtor theb bzhi par bar do'i gtor ma dang / gtor ma 'di bar do la gnang ba zhu/ lnga pa gzhi bdag gtor ma bshams/ zan ril lhag ma thams cad blugs/ rim bzhin sbyangs la/ gzhi bdag gtor ma'i sgang la gtor theb dang po gsum la bshal chu btang nas/ gtor theb dang po zlum gtor gcig dang / gnyis par gcig gsum par bgegs gtor bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gsungs pa'i tshe/ de rnams sbyangs la cha gsum gtor ma la chab/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang gsungs pa'i tshe/ gtor theb dang po gnyis dang phyi ma gnyis po la bshal chu btang / chu gtsang zan gyi ye med par blugs la bzhag oṃ sarba bigh+nan gats+tsha gsungs pa'i tshe bgegs gtor skyur/ chu bo la bshal chu btang / chu gtsang gis bkang nas bzhag de nas spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo gsungs pa'i tshe/ gong bzhin spyan ras gzigs kyi mchod sbyin gnang ba zhu zer ba gong bzhin rigs 'dra rnams nor 'khrul med par brjod/ 'di la snga thog gtor skad kyi skabs zhal 'don bshol ba zhig yod 'dug kyang / deng sang bzhin zhal 'don gyi mu la brjod kyang 'gal ba med/ mjug 'gro la bde skyid ma/ byang phyogs sogs/ 'gro ba'i sogs/ mi 'gyur sogs/ ༈ dus ja dkyus ma la/ skyabs sems nyer gcig dkyus bzhin la/ ja mchod skal bzang ma/ gsol ja grub nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/ shes bya kun la sh+lau ka dang po bcu gcig yongs rdzogs dang gnyis char gdangs ma byin brlabs char 'bebs ma re mos/ 'dzam gling che dgu ma/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma/ ngag dbang lha yi ma/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma/
