'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang ngag gi dbang phyug ma re mos/ skyabs gnas bslu med ma/ 'gro la rjes brtse ma/ tshe'i dngos grub ma dang yang snying ma re mos/ de nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i zhal ngo'i brtan bzhugs bden tshig 'dra yod na gang rigs kyi mthar ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka sogs gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs/ rab mdzes ma/ rgya chen ma/ bsod ye ba/ de nas phyag 'tshal dang bcas lam 'bras phyag mchod mdzad pa'i mchod pa nas bzung bzhugs nas mdzad srol ltar/ mchod yon me tog nas bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig gi bar/ mchod pa bsang sbyang / sngon 'gro'i mchod yon phal cher ma/ rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma/ deng nas byang chub ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga zhes sogs dang / sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma sogs zhes pa tshang ma/ bdag ni thog med ma/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ thos rgya ma/ sems brtse ma/ thob bya'i ma/ byams pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ dpa' bo chen po ma dang chags pa'i skyon bral re mos/ de nas gang blo ma/ de nas chos kyi skabs yin na 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ chos med skabs brtse ldan sogs/ zhi ba gdong bzhi ma/ lo bstod a la la ste ma dang dad chu ma gnyis re mos/ rigs rus cho 'brang ma/ yon tan mchog mnga' ma/ tshangs dbang ma/ khyod nyid ma dang tshangs spyod ma re mos/ srid bral ma/ chos rnams ma tshar lnga/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs/ chos rgyal ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ma/ grags ldan ma/ bsod nams ye shes ma/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho ma/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ma/ mang thos nags tshal ma/ rgya chen ma sh+lau ka gcig rab mdzes ma sh+lau ka gcig dus gsum rgyal mkhyen ma/ rigs gsum rnam 'phrul ma/ dkon mchog gsum dngos ma sh+lau ka gcig shes bya kun la ma/ byams pa'i dpa' mnga' ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ grags pa rgyal mtshan ma/ ngag gi dbang po ma/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma/

sngon tshe chos rgyal ma/ mdo rgyud man ngag ma/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma/ lha mchog ngag dbang ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ skyabs gnas bslu med ma/ 'gro la rjes brtse ma rnams te grags ldan ma nas 'di bar tshang ma sh+lau ka re/ ngag dbang lha yi ti la ka sogs tshang ma/ de nas gsol ja gnyis pa mchod/ gsol ja grub nas rgyal sras ngag dbang ma sogs mkhan bstod yongs rdzogs/ yon tan tshad med ma/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs bkra shis mdzad nas gung gseng la phebs/ gung gseng bsdus nas/ phar tshad brgyud 'debs gdangs ma/ sangs rgyas bstan nyi ma/ gsung rab rgya mtsho ma/ rab sde rba gsum re mos kyi rba rlabs ma gdangs/ thub bstan gser khang ma dang / rin chen dkon mchog ma re mos/ rgyal kun rigs bdag ma/ nyes pas ma gos ma dang rgya chen ma'i mthar bsod nams ye shes ma sbyar ba gnyis re mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo sogs/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma dang zab yangs ma re mos kyis zab yangs mar gdangs/ dkon mchog gdung 'dzin ma/ shes bya kun la ma dang byin rlabs char 'bebs ma re mos kyi gnyis char la gdangs/ bsod nams dbang po/ grags blo ba gnyis kyi sku bstod gsum re mos/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi sku bstod sh+lau ka re yod pa dang / sgar chen sku 'bring / mus chen gyi sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma rnams/ mus chen gyi rgyal ba gnyis pa ma/ spyan snga ba dang ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku bstod/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma dang ngag dbang lha yi ma re mos/ ngag dbang lha yi rjes bzung ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos ma/ lha mchog ngag dbang ma/ bsod nams dbang phyug gi rgyal ba gnyis pa ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma dang / 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs re mos/ bslu med bla ma dang sbrel ba'i spyi bshags/ skyabs gnas bslu med dang dus gsum rgyal ba re mos/ 'gro la rjes brtse dang rnam kun mchog ldan ma re mos/

'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i gdung brgyud kyi zhabs brtan sna mang yod tshe re mos/ gang zhig dad pa'i bla ma'i sogs skor ja 'grim/ rgyal sras ngag dbang ma sogs mkhan bstod yongs rdzogs/ dpal ldan mkhyen brtse ma/ byams pas legs bzung ma/ mang thos ma/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs ma/ skye ba kun tu sogs gcig 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs skor bya log 'gro la bde skyid ma shur ma/ smon lam bkra shis dbu byed nas 'os 'tshams re byed rgyu ni dus ja dkyus ma gtong rim yin zhing / 'di la slan chad chos spyod kyis khungs brje 'phrul dgos pa rnams ma gtogs/ 'phar ma'i rigs sh+lau ka gcig kyang mi spor/ dmigs bsal tshes brgyad 'khrungs ja la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs dbyangs sgo gsum dang ba'i sogs/ bcu gnyis dus ja la ngag dbang lha yi ma'i rjes su bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ bco lnga'i dus ja la rgyun gyi dus ja'i chos spyod mi dgos par thub bstod/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ smon lam 'os 'tsham/ nyer gcig dus ja la ltung bshags gsum dang / nyer lnga la bzang spyod gcig smon lam 'os 'tsham/ hor zla lnga pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ bcu gcig pa rnams kyi ser 'du'i skabs 'jam gcig dang mang ja bzhi re gtong ba'i/ dang po la dus ja dkyus bzhin/ gnyis par dus ja dkyus bzhin la lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi tshab rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma/ de rjes sa skya'i rje btsun ma man gong bzhin/ bzang spyod mchod rol bcas tshar gcig sogs nas gung gseng skabs/ zhabs bskor mdzad dus mchod phreng 'byon khar bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bskul nas rdzogs pa'i bar bya/ de nas bla ma su yin gyi sku bstod sh+lau ka re gdangs thung lta bus skyor/ rgyab mar phyag 'tshal mdzad skabs kyang yan lag bdun pa sogs bskul tshul gong bzhin bya/ zhabs bskor 'gugs nas gung gseng 'dus 'phral bzang spyod mchod rol bcas bskul mtshams gang 'os su ja gsum pa mchod/

ja rgyab la bla ma gong ma gang yin de'i sku bstod gdangs dbyangs bcas kyi mthar sgo gsum dang ba'i sogs tshigs bcad gtso bsdus rnams grub nas bzang spyod kyi 'phros gtong / yang bzang spyod shur ma gcig btang nas gung gseng mdzad/ mang ja bzhi pa'i thog ja rgyab la ring 'tsho'i bden tshig sku rim sgrol gsol bzlog pa sogs gang rigs smon lam bkra shis rgyas pa/ 'bum ther dus la bzlog pa 'bum ther gyi skabs skyabs sems dkyus bzhin/ dkar cha bzhi grol nas 'jam/ de nas yon sbyong gi gzungs smon lam dang bcas/ thabs mkhas thugs rje ma/ sems brtse ma/ thob bya ma/ byams 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ gong bstod rgyas pa/ mkhan bstod yon tan tshad med ma rnams grub nas dngos gzhi bzlog pa nyin re bzhin dgu tshar dgu re/ mtshan brjod 'bum ther skabs skyabs 'gro nas yon sbyong gi gzungs smon lam bcas kyi bar gong bzhin la thabs mkhas thugs rje ma/ sems brtse ma kha skong bcas/ byams 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ dngos gzhi mtshan brjod tshar bcu gsum/ sgrol ma 'bum ther la skyabs sems nas gong bstod rgyas pa rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dngos gzhi phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bdun cu don gnyis re/ 'bum ther de rnams kyi ja rgyab la sngags 'chang yab sras nas bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid kyi bar gyi bla ma gong ma la sku bstod gnyis gsum yod pa rnams re mos/ nyin sngon ma gnyis la mjug rgyun bzhin/ grol nyin rnams la 'gro la bde skyid smon lam bkra shis bcas gdangs ma dang / cho 'phrul smon lam skabs tshes gcig spyi pa'i 'jam mang ja la/ 'jam gyi chos thug tshul bzhin/ mang jar skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i ja mchod skal bzang ma'i mjug gdangs ring bcas/ ja rgyab la shes bya kun la ma nas/ rgya chen ma rdzogs pa'i bar dus ja bzhin la/ de nas rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma/ de nas phyogs bcu dus gsum ma man dus ja bzhin/

ja shul la ltung bshags gcig bzang spyod gcig rdzogs nas gsum pa zhu/ byams smon gcig rnams shur ma dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma'i dbyangs rdzogs nas skor ja gtong / de nas bdag gi sogs/ smon lam rgyal po sogs gdangs dang / 'gro la bde skyid ma/ tshes gnyis la byams smon shur ma gcig ltung bshags gsum/ bzang spyod gnyis kyi rjes la shur ma/ byams smon gsum/ mi mjed ma dbyangs bcas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma dbyangs bcas/ 'gro la bde skyid ma dang bsngo smon shur ma gang 'os bcas mdzad/ tshes gsum gong bzhin la mi mjed ma shur ma/ tshes bzhi'i 'jam thog tshes gcig bzhin/ dgong mo smon lam skabs byams smon gcig ltung bshags gsum/ bzang spyod gcig tshugs 'phral dang po zhu/ yan lag bdun pa rdzogs nas ja mchod gtang / gsol ja bzhes/ de nas sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsum gyi dang po gnyis la dbyangs/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod ma gsum/ byang chub snying po ma rnams gdangs ma gsum/ deng dus bdag tshe sogs/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs/ 'phros dang bzang spyod tshang ma gnyis/ byams smon lnga/ chos rnams thams cad sogs/ ji ltar bu mo sogs/ bdag gi byang chub sogs/ gtsug lag rnams ni klog pa dang zhes pa'i mtshams su gsum pa zhu/ rang bde 'dod la ma/ skye ba kun tu ma sogs/ sbyin pa 'di yis sogs kyi mtshams su lag bde ba rnams tshogs la 'jug mi mjed ma dbyangs/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma dbyangs bcas/ 'gro la bde skyid ma shur ma/ bsngo smon tshigs bcad gdangs ma/ 'di gnyis tshes lnga bdun dgu bcu gcig bcu gsum bco lnga rnams la re mos/ ༈ tshes lngar gzhan gong bzhin la/ bsngo le'i dud 'gro rnams ni gcig ces pa nas/ 'chi ba'i sgra yang grags ma gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gdangs/ mi mjed ma shur ma 'di gnyis re mos/ ༈ tshes drug dang / ༈ bdun la gzhan gong bzhin la byams smon gnyis 'phar/

༈ tshes brgyad la thog mar bzhugs nas byams smon tshar gcig bzhengs nas dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i spyi phyag sems brtse ma gcig ltung bshags gsum/ bla ma rdor 'dzin ma gsum/ lus kyi las ni sogs/ bzhugs nas mchod pa maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'i bar dus ja bzhin la/ gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang / deng nas byang chub ma la dbyangs re mos/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sogs gong mtshungs/ bzang spyod bzhi'i dang po 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ byams smon dgu la dbu tshugs pas sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phra dpon gyis drang srong sogs/ bskul 'dogs pas byang chub sems dpa' sogs chos 'khor ma/ 'gro drug ma/ bdag 'dzin ma rnams la rim bzhin btsun chung re re 'phar/ sa'am ma nas btsun chung bcu 'phar la gdangs kyang cung zad brel/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung ma dbyangs bcas/ skye ba kun tu ma dang / skye ba 'di dang ma'i dbyangs gnyis re mos/ ༈ tshes dgu la gzhan gong mtshungs las bzang spyod gsum/ ༈ bcu dang / gcu gcig la gzhan gong mtshungs la byams smon bcu gcig ༈ bcu gnyis/ ༈ bcu gsum la gzhan gong mtshungs la byams smon bcu gsum/ ༈ bcu bzhi la gzhan gong mtshungs la bzang spyod lnga/ byams smon bco lnga/ ༈ bco lnga la gzhan gong mtshungs la bzang spyod bdun/ byams smon bcu bdun/ mjug 'gro la bde skyid ma dang / smon lam bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rgyas gdangs ma/ nyin mo bde legs ma dbyangs bcas/ 'di skabs mang ja'i gung gseng la dbu mdzad kyis bskul nas phar phyin pa dang btsun chung bka' bzhi pa rnams kyis mngon rtogs rgyan yug gcig gam/ phral nas nyin re la gzhung tshar re 'don/ ༈ hor zla bzhi pa'i dge tsha chen mo'i skabs/ skyabs sems nas bzung ja mchod bar dus ja bzhin dkyus 'dra/ ja rgyab gang 'os gtong tshul sems brtse ma kha skong bcas/

byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ma/ gang gi blo gros/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab ma/ mtshan brjod/ gang tshe sogs/ zhi ba gdong bzhi sogs lo bstod yongs rdzogs nas tshogs gnyis sogs sh+lau ka de nas gang bstod rgyas pa/ sngags 'chang yab sras sogs gong ma so so'i sku bstod nas/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig yongs rdzogs sam 'os rigs/ dpal mo gang zhig nas gzungs ring dang tshe gzungs gang mang / sgrol bzlog mjug 'gro la bde skyid ma nas bkra shis rgyas pa bcas/ lo re'i tsha tsha'i skabs kyang gong mtshungs la ja rgyab spyi phyag gdangs ring dang sku bstod so sor rgyas pa re gtong / hor zla bdun pa'i dbyar mthong skabs 'jam gyi chos spyod thug tshul bzhin chos grwar 'tshogs nas skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i ja mchod bskal bzang ma'i mjug gdangs rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun gyi mang ja bzhin chos khrims pas tshogs skad dang / rab 'byams pas bshad pa rdzogs nas/ phar tshad brgyud 'debs/ de nas rig lung mdzad pa'i bar gsol ja gang yod la ja mchod 'os 'tsham dang / ja rgyab shes bya kun la ma/ byin rlabs char 'bebs ma/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig bsam myur ma rnams rim gtong / mjug 'gro la bde skyid ma dang / bsngo smon shis brjod gdangs bcas/ nyin mo bde legs mar dbyangs bcas/ ༈ hor zla dgu pa'i smon lam 'phar mar tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar bzang spyod gsum/ gcig nas bco lnga'i bar byams smon dgu re/ gcig nas bdun gyi bar mi mjed ma dang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma la dbyangs/ brgyad nas bzung rgyal ba'i sku gsung ma dbyangs/ mi mjed ma shur ma/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ skye zhing skye ba sogs/ skye ba 'di dang sogs/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa sogs sh+lau ka nyin tshan gnyis la nyin re mos kyi gdangs/ gzhan cho 'phrul smon lam dang 'dra ba las/ tshes brgyad nas bcu yi bar 'gro la bde skyid ma dang bsngo smon shur ma/ ston zla gang rung gi rigs char/

skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i kar cha bzhi/ thub bstod sems brtse ma kha skong bcas/ gang bstod yongs rdzogs sogs/ bla ma gong ma'i sku bstod rgyas pa bden tshig gsol 'debs kyi bar dang mkhan bstod/ yon tan tshad med ma/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs tshigs bcad 'os 'tsham/ ja mchod gang rigs bcas nyin gsum char 'di bzhin la/ nyin dang por rnam 'grel brgyud 'debs/ gnyis par phar phyin brgyud 'debs/ gsum par rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi sku bstod rnams/ dbyar dgun gyi spyi pa dang mdzod pa rab 'byams gzhi len rnams la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ bir bstod nas/ 'phags bstod rdzogs pa'i bar rgyas pa/ de nas grags ldan ma sogs sh+lau ka re re byas pa rnams/ rab mdzes ma sh+lau ka gcig dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma lus pa sogs/ rigs gsum rnam 'phrul sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs sh+lau ka re/ shes bya kun la ma yongs rdzogs/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma/ grags pa rgyal mtshan ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma/ sngon tshe chos kyi ma/ mdo rgyud man ngag ma rnams sh+lau ka re/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gnyis yongs rdzogs/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma sngon 'gro'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / skyabs gnas bslu med ma/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig rnams yongs rdzogs kyi mtha' tshigs bcad gang 'os re bskul/ gzhi len chen mo 'di la 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bsgrigs rim zur gsal zhig 'dug kyang / ha cang rgyas stabs rig lung la gnod pa yong tshul mkhan rin po che kun dga' zla 'od nas gsungs shing / slan chad bsdus pa re gtong dgos tshul mdzad 'dug kyang / da phyin chad gzhi len chen mo gangs nyi shar tsam la tshogs nas sa srib la grol rgyu byas thog chos spyod kyang sngags 'chang bla ma'i gsung sor bzhag bkod na/

thog mar skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor nyer gcig bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa/ byang chub snying po ma gdangs/ deng dus bdag tshe nas sems can rnams la de 'byor shog gi bar/ sems brtse ma dang / zhi ba gdong bzhi ma gdangs ma/ a la la ste ma/ rigs rus cho 'brang ma/ tshangs dbang ma/ tshangs spyod ma/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/ skabs 'dir gsol ja dang po la ja mchod skal bzang ma mjug gdangs/ chos rgyal ma gdangs ring / bar gdangs/ gdangs thung bcas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ma/ bla ma dam par/ theg chen/ g.yag rong / kun mkhyen rnams kyi sku bstod sh+lau ka re/ yon tan tshad med ma/ rab mdzes ma gdangs/ shes bya kun la ma bcu gcig sh+lau ka dang por dbyangs yongs rdzogs gdangs ring bcas/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma gdangs/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ba bcu gcig 'dzam gling che dgu ma yongs rdzogs/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ grags pa'i mkha' khyab ma bcu gcig legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma gdangs/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma gdangs ma/ sgar chen gyi sku bstod sh+lau ka gcig sku 'bring gi sku bstod/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma bcu gcig rgyal ba gnyis pa ma gdangs ma/ spyan snga rin po che dang ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku bstod/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan gnyis gdangs ma/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma yongs rdzogs/ rgyal ba gnyis pa ma/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma sngon 'gro'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ skyabs gnas bslu med ma/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs rnams gdangs bcas/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi sku bstod nas/ 'di bar gtong tshul sa skya pa kun blos bris/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs/ bla ma sku khams sogs/ sku bsod ri bo sogs/ gsang chen ma gdangs ma/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ skye ba 'di dang sogs/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa sogs/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/

de nas gsol ja gnyis pa la ja mchod ngo mtshar phun tshogs/ de rjes sder kha'i thog chos las pas bshad pa/ de nas gzhis byes bstan pa'i rnam gzhag pa rnams kyis pod chen drug ka la rig lung cha snyoms mdzad pa'i bar la nyung ja dang mang ja gnyis rim pas btang ba'i ja mchod oṃ las ma dang he ru ka dpal rig lung rdzogs nas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs bzang spyod kyi 'phro dang / bdag gis dus gsum ma yongs rdzogs/ 'gro la bde skyid ma/ bsngo smon bkra shis tshigs bcad rnams gdangs ma dang / nyin mo bde legs ma dbyangs bcas/ gcig skyur la sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs spyan 'dren nas bzhugs gsol gyi bar/ bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa/ byang chub snying po nas de 'byor shog gi bar/ thabs mkhas ma/ byams dkyil ma/ gang blo ma/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ bir bstod dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs gang bstod kyi gzhung bsrangs nas mkhan bstod yan/ yon tan tshad med ma/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ de nas ja mchod gang rung / mchod yar grub rjes sngar gyi bzang spyod 'phro dang / byams smon/ 'gro la bde skyid ma/ smon lam bkra shis 'thus tsam mdzad/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i mtshan brjod 'di sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can gyi sku tshe'i smad tsam nas chag cing / dam pa de nyid kyi sku thog la 'dzugs gnang mdzad 'dug kyang zhib cha ma byung bas de 'phral bla mchod la 'gyur 'dug pa bcas/ da phyin chad lo 'di'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas bzung zla ba byung ngo cog gi bcu bzhi la sdom gsum gzhung skyor skabs gnas khang gang yang rung bar nged nas phul ba'i sa paṇa zhal thang drung mchod pa lnga la zhal zas gsum/ dkar me gsum bcas bshams nas chos spyod kyi rim pa/ thog mar skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/

dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs shes bya thams cad gzigs pa sh+lau ka gcig hor zla bcu gcig bar tshar nyer gcig dang zla ba gzhan rnams la bdun re/ bcu gcig pa chos rgyal ma gdangs ring 'bring tha gsum bcas/ zla ba gzhan rnams la chos rgyal ma 'dur ma re bton pa'i mthar sdom gsum gzhung la 'dur gdangs dang bcas skabs gsum dang / gnad rnams 'khrul med dpyad dgos so zhes pa rnams bskul mtshams/ gsol ja gsum gtong ba'i skabs dang po rdzogs nas gcig gnyis pa sngags sdom gyi phyed tsam la/ gsum pa rgya skad tshugs mtshams su gtang ba'i ja mchod mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs/ rin chen 'brug rgya ma sogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa sa skya lo tsā sogs/ sdom gsum rdzogs nas sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan/ de bzhin bshegs pa mi 'khrugs sogs/ bdag gis dus gsum sogs/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs yan lag bcu pa/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs mdzad rgyu yin pas rab 'byams pa tshang mas lo 'di'i hor zla bcu gcig pa yan la sdom gsum mthar phyin zhig 'dzin sbyong mdzad ngos/ mi brjed dran shes brtan pas zla skyor skabs tshang mas 'ur chil gyi gsung chog pa zhig dgos rgyu dang / ༈ sdom gsum kha skong bdud rtsi'i nying khu bcas zla re la tshar re lha khang bla brang nas gnang dgos la ja gsum bka' bcu pa gsar 'phel thog 'gyed sman kha re tsam bcas kyi gzhung don skabs nged rang nas phul ba'i kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal thang drung / mchod pa gong mtshungs bshams nas skyabs sems nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gong bzhin de nas bla ma gong ma'i gsung la gzhi byas nged rang nas brtsams pa'i sdom gsum brgyud 'debs zla ba gzhan rnams la rgya chen ma bdun/ bsod nams ye shes ma dang / nyes pas ma gos pa gnyis re mos/ hor zla dang po'i nyer gcig 'di kun mkhyen gyi dus chen yin pas rgya chen ma nyer gcig

bsod nams ye shes ma gdangs ma/ nyes pas ma gos ma sgo gsum dang ba'i sogs gdangs ma/ sdom gsum kha skong bdud rtsi nying khu'i rtsa ba bcas 'don rgyu la/ skabs lnga la bskul mtshams re/ ja dang por ja mchod gang 'os/ ja rgyab gdung rabs bsdus pa/ gnyis par ja mchod gang 'os/ ja rgyab phun tshogs dge legs ma/ gsum par ja mchod gang sku 'jigs rung ma/ ja rgyab ring 'tsho'i bden tshig bdud rtsi nying khu rdzogs nas smon lam bkra shis gong bzhin/ ༈ zla re'i tshe chog gsum la sgrub dkyil nyid kyi gzhung bsrang bdag bskyed la gzungs ring zhe gcig gzungs thung gnyis brgya rtsa/ mdun bskyed dang bum skyed gnyis la gzung ring so lnga re/ bum bskyed kyi gzungs thung gnyis phreng bskor/ las bum gyi bzlas pa nyer gcig mjug tu 'chi med dpal sbyin ma gzungs ring gsum/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma gdangs bcas/ ༈ tshogs chen cho ga'i kun rig rnams kyi skabs thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs/ dkar cha/ de nas cho ga tshugs pa'i khro bo spyan 'dren tshugs bstun 'jam len/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs gang rigs la 'jam bzhes/ bzlas pa dang mchod pa rdzogs pa'i mtshan brgyad dril gsil skabs ja dang po len/ bum bskyed bzlas pa tshugs 'phral zhus nas skabs gang rung la mchod/ mdun bskyed kyi spyan 'dren grol mtshams zhib dang mar thud bkye/ 'phrin las grol mtshams gsol ja gnyis pa len/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i skabs zhus nas/ rol mo rdzogs mtshams sogs gang rung la mchod/ 'dod yon rdzogs nas gung gseng dbang gi dngos gzhi tshugs nas gsum pa len/ bdag sgrub bzlas pa tshugs 'phral gsum pa zhus nas skabs gang rung la mchod/ bdag bum sgrub gsum gyi bzlas pa brgya bcu gcig re/ gdangs dang cho ga byings dal bus gtong srol yod pa bzhin bya/ rnam rgyal stong mchod skabs spyi phyag gdangs cung mgyogs pa/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i gzhung bsrangs bdag mdun gnyis kyi dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi mchod bstod rdzogs mtshams shub bu'i ngag gis gtso mo'i thugs kar bh+rūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar zhes pa nas/

bh+rūṃ yig dkar po zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la/ bsrung bya ni rang rang la ltos pa'i sna tshogs yod pas/ de dag mi brjod par yin gyis gang bsrung ba de bsams la ngag 'don de'i mtha' bskor du sngags rnams kyi zhes pa nas/ ye shes thams cad rgyas par gyur zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin brjod la/ legs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas me tog bzung nas gzungs ring tshar gcig shub bu/ de nas bdag bskyed la gzungs ring grangs gsog la 'jug mdun bskyed la legs sbyin gyi sngags rdzogs pa'i rjes su me tog bum par gtor/ mchod pa sogs stong chog dngos la 'jug bsrung bya gsal 'debs dang / legs sbyin gyi sngags shub bu 'di ni bdag mdun gnyis char la bya'o/ /bdag bskyed la gzungs ring / a mri ta dang bsrung sngags rnams gsum re/ mdun bskyed la stong mchod 'gro dgos pas grwa bcu gcig yod skabs grwa res gzungs ring brgya re bzla dgos pas grwa res bcu tshan bdun ma song bar bzhugs nas bcu mtshams su mchod pa re/ bcu tshan brgyad pa'i gzungs ring nas bcu pa'i gzungs ring grangs gsog ma rdzogs bar bskor ba/ mchod pa gsum yang bzhengs nas mdzad/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i gtor ma grangs gsog kyang byung na bya dgos pas/ mchod pa/ phyag sngags bskor ba stong rdzogs nas gzungs gtor gyi gong du gtor theb bcu tshar gyi theb rer zan ril che chung gang rung brgya re blug pas stong / de nyid grwa bcus a kā ro'i sngags brgyas bsngos pas stong bya rgyu la nyi shu rtsa lnga re'i mtshams mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis sogs la ting shag dkrol/ gzungs gtor 'bul skabs/ oṃ na mo nas/ ma hā mu dre man+ḍa pa de swāhā'i mthar a kā ro/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swāhā la a kā ro/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yud+dha de swā hā la a kā ro sbyar ba rnams kyis bsngo/ mjug dpal mo gang zhig mas phyag 'tshal kyang bya/ 'dod gsol sh+lau ka re'i mtshams me tog 'thor/

yig brgya sogs gzhung bzhin brgyud 'debs nged rang gi snga rtsom 'di phrug gu'i rtsom pa tshig nyog can byung 'dug pas sa lo'i gsung la kha skong byas par kun rig brgyud 'debs kyi gdangs dang bcas/ rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa 'dir bskul mtshams bcas mdzad na 'thus 'dra zhing / ༈ bstan pa gso chog kyang slar gsar rtsom thub pa byung tshe de bzhin byed/ chog mang skabs tshe chog rnam rgyal gnyis kyi cho ga la cho ga snga rting gnyis char la bdag mdun bum gsum gyi gzungs ring brgya rtsa re/ bdag bum gnyis kyi snying po/ nye snying nyis brgya re/ rnam rgyal gyi spyi phyag gdangs ring dang / cho ga gnyis ka'i bdag bskyed la gzungs ring bcu gcig a mṛ ta'i sngags nyer gcig bsrung sngags gsum gzungs gtor 'bum skabs/ oṃ na mo nas/ a mṛ ta ā yud+dha de swāhā'i mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba gsum gyis bsngo ba rnams mdzad rgyu dang / ༈ tshogs chen rnam rgyal la grwa pa zhal grangs mang bas/ mdun bskyed kyi stong mchod grangs gsog tshul deng sang ltar mdzad 'thus shing / gtor ma grangs gsog kyang shom gong bzhin la/ a kā ro bcus bsngos mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs mdzad na legs 'dra zhing / ༈ tshes brgyad gtor ma sogs sil gtor mdzad dgos tshang mar gtor ma tshang 'grig tshar gcig gam grangs kha yar sogs gang 'os/ bka' 'gyur dus ma song chos sgrog rnams la/ snga thog smra bsam brjod med sh+lau ka gcig tsam ma gtogs gzhan gsung sgrog kho na mdzad srol yod 'dug kyang / slad char deng song bzhin mgor skyabs 'gro bzhi skor lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam dag chos dbyings nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol gyi bar/ bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa/ smra bsam brjod med sh+lau ka gcig de nas gsung sgrog grol khar po tā la yi sogs sgrol gsol yongs rdzogs 'dod gsol gyi mtha' rten bcas/

mdo tshar gcig bdud bzlog gsum/ mjug gi tshigs bcad shur ma rnams kyi mthar/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs mdzad rgyu dang / ja mchod ja rgyab nyung ngu 'don na ma gtogs dus ma rnams la ha cang gi rgyas pa mi bya zhing / ༈ 'jam 'don gzungs 'don la chos spyod gtong tshul dang / ༈ gdung brgyud khri phebs dga' ston sogs la chos spyod gtong tshul so sor zur gsal re yod pas de bzhin bya/ ༈ sbyin bdag so so'i 'dod pas 'phar ma gtong tshul ni mang ja'i skabs kyang sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gnyis/ zhing khams brjes nas zhabs brtan rgyas pa rnams ma btang 'dug pas bla ma zhing gshegs kyi zhabs brtan gyi rigs rnams de tshe de dus lta bu ma gtogs chos spyod 'khob chung ba'i phyir rgyun 'jug mi bya/ dus ja'i chos spyod du ma gtogs pa mdzad bcu'i bstod pa/ gnas brtan phyag mchod/ 'jam dbyangs bstod pa byin rlabs skul byed/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/ bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ smon lam rnam mang / bla mchod/ ri khrod ma'i mngon rtogs rnams ma bzhugs pas mang ja phyi 'dren gyi rigs la gong bkod chos spyod rnams re mos dang / 'di dag kyang gang la gang 'tshams su sbyar nas chos khrims pas gsal dang bstun dbu mdzad nas skul lugs byas ngos/ dus ja'i chos spyod kyi dod tsam pher ba sogs mang ja nyung dang bstun pa'i bskul lugs byas pas rgyas bsdus nye 'gyangs med pa zhig gtang ba dang / gtor ma tshe chog kun rig sogs la'ang des rigs 'gre zhing / chos sgrogs kyi skabs kyang bla ma'i sku bstod sogs sbyin bdag rang gis gang zhus la sbyor dngos rjes gtsang mdzad 'tshal/ zhes nged rang nas brtsams pa'i bca' yig las chos spyod gtong tshul zur gsal 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba dge/

༈ /nged rang sogs zhal ngo rnams kyi rim gro'ang nyin gong ma rnams da phyin chad chos grwa grol nas gtong zhing gung tshigs dang dgong thun yod skabs mi gtong bka' 'gyur 'phar rigs chos thog bdun gyi chos mtshams so sor gang 'os su gtong / gzhan rang rang gi mchod gnas pa rnams mang ja grol nas gdan 'dren/ chos thog bdun gyi skabs tshes grangs gang 'os la gung tshigs dang dgong thun gnyis zung 'brel lam/ phral nas lan re chag med gtong / 'di dag la snga sor bsnyen bkur gtan nas mi 'dug kyang mang ja sogs 'gro 'os byung na mkhan rin po che las thog par bka' bkod kyi babs gzigs dang / gong 'khod chos kyi sku rim mdzad rgyu zhig 'dug kyang / deng sang ni dmigs khungs zhig ma byung zhes pa ni/ bca' yig chen mo las/ spyi bsod 'dus nas hor zla bcu gcig sa mgo zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpon slob 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i ched du chos rim mdzad dgos rgyu la nyin phyed yan bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gsung sgrog sher snying bdud bzlog phyi dro'i cha la yon tan rgya mtsho ma dang / chos rgyal ma gtso bor bton pa'i gong bstod sogs/ bla ma'i sku bstod sgrol ma tshar sum cu so bdun sgrol gsol dang bcas pa/ sher snying bdud bzlog rnams gang 'jug mdzad ces gsungs pas/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zhes pa yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la 'jog kyang / bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs thon tshe de bas kyang ngo mtshar che bas/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi sku dus la gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur dus ma gsum gyi rgyal zla'i bka' 'gyur 'di mgo zla'i tshes gcig nas lnga'i bar la yar 'then/ thug tshul grol nas nyin phyed yan gsung sgrog nyin phyed man bla ma'i sku bstod sogs gong bkod rnams dbu byed la yod pa'i tho zur bzhin mdzad na 'thus 'dra bas de bzhin 'tshal//

༈ /hor zla dang po'i bco lnga la byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyas kyi bla mchod skabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid kyi gzhung srang brgyud 'debs rnam dag la rgyas pa/ bir bstod nas 'phags bstod sangs rgyas kun gyi ma rdzogs pa'i bar/ grags ldan ma nas mang thos nags tshal ma'i bar/ yon tan tshad med ma/ rab mdzes ma/ tshangs ma/ ngag pa/ tshe na/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ zhabs drung ngag gi dbang po/ rgyal sras ngag dbang ma rnams sh+lau ka re/ shes bya kun la ma/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched nas/ bsod nams dbang phyug bar gyi sku bstod gang rung yongs rdzogs shur ma/ nged rang gis gsar btsugs/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi sku bstod sh+lau ka dang po brgya rtsa dang / yongs rdzogs gdangs ma sgo gsum dang ba'i sogs/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ dam pa de nyid rnams kyi sku bstod/ bstan 'dzin zhal ngo'i ring 'tsho'i bden tshig gcig mchod phreng nas gsang chen ma/ rdzogs pa'i bar dang / de'i mjug gi tshigs bcad/ bzang spyod yongs rdzogs tshar gcig bdag gi dus gsum ma/ 'gro la bde skyid ma shur ma/ bsngo smon bkra shis 'os 'tshams bya/ ston chos kyi sku rim la/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i sgrol gsol bzlog pa gang 'gro dang / ja rgyab la bsam myur ma/ ring 'tsho'i bden tshig rnams gang 'os/ mgo zla'i bka' 'gyur la gsung sgrogs kyi sgrig rim gong bkod bzhin nyin phyed yan bskul chung pa sogs kyis bskul/ phyed man la dbu byed byon nas skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor gsum/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gdangs ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ spyan 'dren nas bzhugs gsol gyi bar gdangs ma thabs mkhas thugs rje sh+lau ka gcig byams pa'i dkyil 'khor ma/ gang blo ma/ brtse ldan khyed kyi sogs/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs bir bstod gnyis re mos/ rigs rus cho 'brang ma dang / sa chen gyi bstod pa/ khyod nyid ma dang / tshangs spyod ma re mos/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/

chos rnams ma dang / shes bya thams cad gzigs pa nyer gcig chos rgyal ma sogs gong bstod yongs rdzogs kyi rjes su/ po tā la yi gnas mchog sogs nas rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog gi bar/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar so bdun/ lha mo la gus sogs yongs rdzogs/ sher snying bdud bzlog dgu tshar/ mjug gi tshigs bcad rnams dang / 'gro la bde skyid ma shur ma/ smon lam bkra shis 'os 'tshams bcas// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i bca' yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
